name: 开心果绿西装·独轮车山地速降
desc: 开心果绿西装绅士驾单轮独轮车速降翡翠绿山脊，跳崖飞跃豁口，时装编辑片质感的超现实极限运动大片。
original:
[REFERENCE CONTROL] @Video 1 defines ONLY the exact 30-second action and editing blueprint: shot order, cut timing, downhill route, rider trajectory, stunt timing, camera positions, tracking paths, lens changes, foreground wipes, speed changes and audio rhythm. Translate the bicycle performance into physically believable extreme mountain-unicycle riding. Do not inherit the original rider, orange sportswear, helmet, bicycle design, dry brown palette or visual styling. @Image 1 is the canonical identity, fashion, unicycle, environment and color reference. Preserve the same adult man, short dark hair, facial structure, pistachio-green tailored suit, pale-green shirt, cropped trousers and black loafers throughout. No helmet, sportswear or visible protective equipment. Preserve the pictured unicycle's mint frame, chrome seat post, black saddle, silver rim, single black tire, crank and two pedals. Adapt the tire only with subtle mountain tread; do not otherwise redesign it. Use the image's saturated emerald landscape, scattered oranges, soft telephoto rendering, restrained editorial mood and exact green-forward color treatment. It is a visual reference, not a first frame.

[REFERENCE LOCK] Exactly one man, one unicycle, one wheel and one continuous downhill route. The output must never contain a bicycle, second wheel, handlebar, fork resembling a bicycle, extra rider or duplicate person. Keep the same face, hair, suit, shoes and unicycle from first frame to last.

[STYLE AND ENVIRONMENT] A surreal high-fashion extreme-sports film. Transform @Video 1's exposed alpine route into an intensely green mountain landscape while preserving its exact geography: steep chute, narrow trail, first berm, linked S-turns, three stone steps, cliff straight, natural gap and safe landing shelf. Velvet emerald slopes, pale pistachio grass, deep forest-green shadows and occasional small oranges scattered safely outside the riding line. The oranges remain stationary and never obstruct the rider. Match @Image 1's grading precisely: layered saturated greens, pistachio tailoring separated subtly from the landscape, warm-neutral skin, lifted blacks, low-to-medium contrast, soft highlight roll-off, restrained halation, fine 35mm grain, gentle motion blur and no digital oversharpening. Elegant deadpan fashion editorial, not conventional sports advertising.

[DIRECTOR GRAMMAR] External camera crew only. No POV, helmet camera, chest camera or first-person view. Preserve @Video 1's exact hard-cut structure and camera choreography. The rider continuously travels from high frame to low frame and generally screen-left to screen-right. Re-establish the downhill direction immediately after every cut. Cut only on wheel impact, body lean or foreground occlusion.

0-2s – Stabilized aerial 70mm extreme wide looking diagonally down the terrifying green ridge. The man enters at the top edge, chooses the steeper chute without stopping and drops immediately. Camera dives to reveal the entire fall line. Bass impact as the single wheel crosses the ridge break.

2-5s – Hard cut to locked 135mm side view across the canyon. Long-lens compression makes the gradient severe. He pedals rapidly through frame while the camera pans down just enough to hold him. A foreground rock wipes the lens.

5-8s – Rock wipe reveals a ground-level 24mm beside the first berm. He leans the unicycle aggressively and carves past within one meter, left to right. Exactly one tire throws one physically sourced fan of gravel backward. Camera shakes once from the pass and holds the empty trail for four frames.

8-12s – Stabilized 24mm chase drone four meters behind and three meters above. It dives at matching speed through two linked S-turns. His pedal cadence matches wheel rotation; hips, knees and arms make controlled balancing corrections while preserving full downhill speed.

12-15s – Cut to a 28mm cable-camera leading him from six meters ahead. He descends three stone steps in one fluid sequence. The single tire contacts each step once; knees and torso compress naturally on each impact. Both feet remain fixed to the two pedals.

15-18s – Hard cut to 85mm lateral long-lens pan across the cliff. He crosses three bands of sun and shadow, leans through one fast berm and releases into the straight. Controlled background streak and one dust ribbon follow the single wheel.

18-21s – Locked ground-level 20mm outside the riding line. He charges directly toward frame, passes safely camera-right at full speed and his pistachio jacket wipes the image. Wind and tire sound peak without camera collision.

21-25s – The pistachio wipe opens to a 35mm aerial side-wide traveling parallel. He accelerates briefly to 115%, compresses downward on the pedals, preload-hops from the natural lip and clears one real gap from left to right. At takeoff, music drops to sub-bass and wind. While airborne, use one 45% slow-motion beat as the drone arcs 30 degrees clockwise. Return to real time before the tire reaches the landing.

25-28s – Cut on single-tire impact to a low 50mm side follow. The tire compresses visibly, his knees and torso absorb the landing and his arms correct balance. One dust burst travels backward. He stays seated over the wheel and accelerates down the final straight.

28-30s – Locked 100mm telephoto at the bottom. He races through frame and exits screen-right without slowing. Music and tire sound cut sharply on exit. Hold the empty emerald trail and drifting dust for the final half-second.

[PHYSICS] All riding must be mechanically coherent for an expert mountain unicyclist. Exactly one wheel at all times. Both feet remain attached to the two pedals. Pedal cadence and crank rotation match wheel speed. The saddle and mint frame remain centered beneath him. Jumps use visible preload from hips, knees and pedals. Landings occur on the single tire with believable compression, balance correction, gravity and momentum.

[AUDIO] Original 150 BPM instrumental: tight breakbeat drums, distorted sub-bass, short metallic percussion and granular synth, without vocals or recognizable melody. Lock beats to berm pressure, stair impacts, takeoff and landing. Layer mountain wind, one-wheel tire roar, gravel spray, pedal and crank clicks, close-pass Doppler, fabric movement and landing thump. No bicycle chain or freehub sounds. No dialogue or voiceover.

[FINAL LOCKS] Same man, same pistachio suit and same mint unicycle throughout. EXACTLY ONE WHEEL. No bicycle, second wheel, handlebar, helmet, sportswear, wardrobe change, duplicated pedals, detached feet, malformed limbs, equipment morphing, extra people, moving oranges, logos, captions or on-screen text. Only the specified airborne slow-motion beat; everything else runs at full believable speed. End after the rider exits and the dust settles.
zh:
【参考控制】@视频1 仅定义精确的30秒动作与剪辑蓝图：镜头顺序、切点时机、下坡路线、骑手轨迹、特技时机、机位、跟踪路径、焦段变化、前景擦镜、速度变化与音频节奏。将自行车表演转译为物理可信的极限山地独轮车骑行。不要继承原骑手、橙色运动服、头盔、自行车造型、干燥棕色调或视觉风格。@图1 是身份、时装、独轮车、环境与色彩的权威参考。全程保持同一位成年男性：深色短发、同一面部结构、开心果绿修身西装、浅绿衬衫、九分西裤与黑色乐福鞋。不戴头盔、不穿运动服、无可见护具。保留图中独轮车的薄荷绿车架、镀铬座管、黑色车座、银色轮圈、单条黑色轮胎、曲柄与两只脚踏。仅可为轮胎加入细微山地胎纹，除此之外不得重新设计。使用图片中的饱和翡翠绿景观、散落的橙子、柔和长焦质感、克制的杂志编辑氛围与精确的绿色主导调色。它是视觉参考，不是首帧。

【参考锁定】始终只有一个男人、一辆独轮车、一只车轮、一条连续下坡路线。画面中绝不能出现自行车、第二只车轮、车把、类似自行车的前叉、额外骑手或重复人物。从首帧到末帧保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一西装、同一双鞋与同一辆独轮车。

【风格与环境】一部超现实的高级时装感极限运动影片。将@视频1 中裸露的高山路线改造成浓烈的绿色山地景观，同时保留其精确地形：陡峭溜槽、狭窄山径、第一个弯墙、连续S弯、三级石阶、悬崖直线段、天然豁口与安全落地台。天鹅绒般的翡翠山坡、浅开心果色草地、深森林绿阴影，以及零星散落在骑行线路之外的小橙子。橙子保持静止，绝不阻挡骑手。精确匹配@图1 的调色：层次分明的饱和绿色、与景观微妙分离的开心果色西装、暖中性肤色、提升的黑位、中低对比度、柔和高光滚降、克制的光晕、细腻35mm胶片颗粒、柔和运动模糊、无数码过度锐化。优雅冷面的时装编辑片气质，而非常规体育广告。

【导演语法】仅用外部摄制组机位。禁止POV、头盔相机、胸前相机或第一人称视角。保留@视频1 精确的硬切结构与运镜编排。骑手持续从画面高处驶向低处，总体从画左向画右。每次剪切后立即重新确立下坡方向。仅在轮胎触地、身体压弯或前景遮挡时剪切。

0-2秒——增稳航拍70mm超大远景，沿骇人的绿色山脊斜向下望。男人从画面顶端入画，毫不停顿地选择更陡的溜槽并立即俯冲。镜头下潜揭示整条坠落线。单轮越过山脊断点时响起低音重击。

2-5秒——硬切至峡谷对岸锁定的135mm侧视机位。长焦压缩令坡度显得极为严酷。他快速踩踏穿过画面，镜头仅以最小幅度下摇保住主体。一块前景岩石擦过镜头。

5-8秒——岩石擦镜揭示第一弯墙旁的地面24mm机位。他猛烈压弯独轮车，在一米内贴身刮过，由左至右。恰好一条轮胎向后甩出一扇符合物理的碎石。镜头因贴身掠过震动一次，并在空荡山径上停留四帧。

8-12秒——增稳24mm追踪无人机，位于后方四米、上方三米。它以匹配速度俯冲穿过两组相连S弯。他的踏频与轮转一致；髋、膝、臂做出受控的平衡修正，同时保持全速下坡。

12-15秒——切至前方六米引导拍摄的28mm索道摄影机。他一气呵成降下三级石阶。单胎每级只触地一次；膝盖与躯干在每次冲击时自然压缩。双脚始终固定在两只脚踏上。

15-18秒——硬切至85mm横向长焦摇摄掠过悬崖。他穿过三段日光与阴影的交替带，压过一个高速弯墙后释放进直线段。受控的背景拉丝与一条尘带尾随单轮。

18-21秒——骑行线外锁定的地面20mm机位。他径直冲向镜头，全速从镜头右侧安全掠过，开心果绿西装外套擦满画面。风声与胎噪达到峰值，但不发生镜头碰撞。

21-25秒——开心果色擦镜展开为35mm平行伴飞的航拍侧向大全景。他短暂加速到115%，向脚踏下压蓄力，从天然起跳唇预压起跳，由左向右飞越一个真实豁口。起跳瞬间，音乐骤降为次低音与风声。滞空期间使用一拍45%慢动作，无人机顺时针弧转30度。轮胎触及落点前恢复实时速度。

25-28秒——在单胎着地瞬间剪切至低机位50mm侧向跟拍。轮胎可见压缩，膝盖与躯干吸收落地冲击，双臂修正平衡。一股尘爆向后掠去。他保持坐姿压住车轮，沿最后的直线段继续加速。

28-30秒——谷底锁定100mm长焦。他不减速地冲过画面，从画右出画。音乐与胎噪在出画瞬间戛然而止。空荡的翡翠山径与飘散尘埃定格最后半秒。

【物理】所有骑行动作必须对一名专业山地独轮车手而言机械可信。任何时刻都只有一只车轮。双脚始终贴在两只脚踏上。踏频与曲柄转速匹配轮速。车座与薄荷绿车架始终位于身体正下方。跳跃需有髋、膝与脚踏的可见预压蓄力。落地由单胎完成，带有可信的压缩、平衡修正、重力与动量。

【音频】原创150 BPM纯器乐：紧凑碎拍鼓组、失真次低音、短促金属打击乐与颗粒感合成器，无人声、无可辨识旋律。将节拍锁定在弯墙压弯、石阶冲击、起跳与落地上。叠加山风、单轮胎噪、碎石飞溅、脚踏与曲柄咔嗒声、贴身掠过的多普勒声、衣料飘动与落地闷响。禁止自行车链条或飞轮声。无对白、无旁白。

【最终锁定】全程同一男人、同一开心果绿西装、同一薄荷绿独轮车。严格只有一只车轮。禁止出现：自行车、第二只车轮、车把、头盔、运动服、换装、重复的脚踏、脱离脚踏的脚、畸形肢体、器材变形、多余人物、移动的橙子、商标、字幕或任何画面文字。只允许指定的滞空慢动作节拍；其余全部以可信的全速运行。骑手出画、尘埃落定后结束。

name: 黑麻绳高定·哈苏时尚大片
desc: 铂金波波头冷艳女主身着黑麻绳雕塑感概念高定，哈苏中画幅胶片质感与闪拍定格交织，束缚终成加冕。
original:
Create a 30-second high-fashion, surreal, concept-driven fashion film. Use the reference image only for the character's presence, hairstyle, makeup, and black hemp-rope element.

The lead is a woman with pale luminous skin, a short straight platinum-blonde bob with blunt bangs, cool sharp blue eyes, natural realistic skin texture, and muted red lips. Her presence is calm, dangerous, distant, commanding, fashionable, and mysterious. The black hemp rope must read as avant-garde, elevated, sculptural, conceptual couture—not ordinary restraint or bondage. Different scenes may use different rope looks, but keep the same look within each scene with no abrupt wardrobe changes. Rope styling may include a high-neck structure, exaggerated shoulders, a facial frame, sculpted shoulder-and-neck contours, arm structures, a back piece, dimensional braiding, and asymmetrical silhouettes.

The overall image should feel like Hasselblad medium-format film photography: a luxury fashion-editorial spread, vintage-film atmosphere, soft but clear rendering, detailed realistic skin, subtle film grain, a low-saturation cool palette, layered pure blacks and cool grays, a slight steel-blue undertone, natural refined highlights, shallow depth of field, and elegant bokeh. The pace should be fast and precise. Do not create rhythm by constantly introducing new locations; build variation through changes in camera position, action, expression, flash-lit cuts, and callback shots. Actions include: lifting the eyes, tilting the head, looking back, raising the chin, lightly touching the rope, adjusting the shoulder-and-neck structure, passing a hand in front of the face, stepping forward, making a half turn, lowering the head and looking up again, and standing still while staring into the lens. Expressions include: an indifferent stare, a contemptuous upward glance, slightly parted lips, briefly closing and reopening the eyes, a provocative stare into camera, and an empty yet sacred gaze. The performance must remain elevated, restrained, editorial, and non-casual. Throughout the film, use several rounds of flash-lit cuts and photographic freeze-frame moments, like a sequence of Hasselblad fashion stills coming to life. Flash cuts may move quickly between a frontal view, profile, extreme close-up of the eyes, close-up of the lips, shoulder-and-neck details, hands touching rope, overhead angles, low angles, and mirror-reflection compositions. Do not use flash-style freeze frames in the twin mirror sequence.

Core concept: What restrained her ultimately becomes her.

Scene structure – approximately 3 seconds per scene, 10 scenes total.

Scene 1 | 0-3s – Frontal close-up awakening
An extreme beauty close-up. Black hemp rope frames her shoulders, neck, and the edges of the image. Introduce the first round of flash-lit cuts with several rapid shots: frontal close-up, eye close-up, lip close-up, and profile close-up. Expression progression: indifferent stare → slightly parted lips → eyes briefly close and reopen.

Scene 2 | 3-6s – Twin mirror composition
Against a pure black background, two versions of her stand facing each other, with black rope wrapping their shoulders, necks, and upper bodies. Shots: medium two-shot, left and right profile close-ups, the two figures looking at each other, and one looking into camera while the other looks across. Expressions and movement: slight head tilts, eye movement, short pauses, parted lips, lowering the head and looking back up. No flash-style freeze frames.

Scene 3 | 6-9s – Hands and black rope close-ups
A bright, minimal background. The rope must not look overly smooth; preserve visible fibers, roughness, slight fraying, and authentic hemp texture. Create more interweaving, crossing, knotting, and layered compression between the strands. Shots: open palm, extended fingers, fine rope crossing through the gaps between fingers, overhead hand composition, and close-ups of fingertips and knots.

Scene 4 | 9-12s – Black stage and main installation
A pure-black stage as the primary hero scene. She stands centered in front of a huge, symmetrical, petal-shaped or interlocking circular black-rope installation, like a black floral crown or dark sacred halo. Shots: ultra-symmetrical full-body wide shot, slow push into a medium shot, low-angle view, and a slight overhead view. Actions: head lowered, slowly lifting her head, taking one gentle step forward, then standing still and looking directly into camera.

Scene 5 | 12-15s – Close-up callback
Return to close framing, now from a high angle with her face slightly turned and the black rope positioned closer to her face. Shots: frontal view, profile, overhead angle, eyes, lips, and a hand lightly touching the rope beside her face. Expressions: provocative, empty, contemptuous. Use a denser sequence of flash-lit cuts.

Scene 6 | 15-18s – Main installation callback
Return to the black-stage installation with the same styling and no wardrobe change. Shots: lateral dolly, looking through the installation, top-down overhead shot, and low-angle orbit. Action: she makes a half turn, stops, and looks back at the camera.

Scene 7 | 18-21s – Installation-art space
Cut to a dark gallery-like installation space filled with suspended black hemp-rope structures and numerous cool metallic black flowers. She stands at the center and gently raises one hand. Do not make the ropes rise abruptly; instead, let the surrounding installation change subtly and in an orderly way, such as the flowers slowly opening. Shots: wide shot, low-angle view, overhead view, close-up, and changes in installation, light, and shadow. The entire space should feel as though it is responding to her presence.

Scene 8 | 21-24s – Twin / hands intercut callback
Return to the twin composition and hand close-ups, intercut at a faster pace: the two figures meet each other's gaze → left figure in profile → hand and rope intertwine → right figure looks into camera → hand glides across rope. A small number of photographic cuts may be used, but do not disrupt the cool, controlled mood of the twin sequence.

Scene 9 | 24-27s – Buildup before the final reveal
Rapidly intercut: frontal close-up stare, full-body main installation, eye close-up, lip close-up, hand touching rope, and the character inside the installation-art space. The edit becomes noticeably faster and the flash-lit cuts more frequent. The audience should feel that she has fully transformed from being "wrapped" into taking control and being crowned.

Scene 10 | 27-30s – Final reveal
A pure black background or deep void, with strong fashion beauty lighting and flash-lit still-image moments. She appears in full; the black hemp rope has become an intensely sculptural conceptual-couture look, like wearable installation art. Hard-cut shots include a frontal cover composition, a medium close-up looking directly into camera, and a hand touching the rope. Avoid large body movements. She lifts her eyes coldly and stares directly into the lens. End on a powerful, frontal, magazine-cover pose.
zh:
创作一支30秒的高级时装、超现实、概念驱动的时尚影片。参考图仅用于角色气质、发型、妆容与黑色麻绳元素。

主角是一位女性：苍白通透的皮肤、齐刘海铂金色直发波波头、冷冽锐利的蓝眼睛、自然真实的皮肤质感、哑致暗红色嘴唇。她的气场冷静、危险、疏离、强势、时髦而神秘。黑色麻绳必须呈现为前卫、高级、雕塑感、概念化的高定时装——而非普通的捆缚或束缚。不同场景可使用不同的绳饰造型，但同一场景内保持同一造型，不得突兀换装。绳艺造型可包含：高领结构、夸张肩部、面部框架、肩颈雕塑轮廓、手臂结构、背部装置、立体编织与不对称剪影。

整体画面应如哈苏中画幅胶片摄影：奢华时尚杂志大片、复古胶片氛围、柔和而清晰的成像、细腻真实的皮肤、微妙胶片颗粒、低饱和冷色调、层次分明的纯黑与冷灰、轻微钢蓝底色、自然精致的高光、浅景深与优雅焦外。节奏应快速而精准。不要靠不断引入新场景制造节奏；通过机位、动作、表情、闪光灯剪切与回调镜头的变化来构建变奏。动作包括：抬眼、偏头、回眸、扬起下巴、轻触绳索、整理肩颈结构、手掠过面前、向前迈步、半转身、低头再抬眼、静立直视镜头。表情包括：冷漠凝视、轻蔑上扬的目光、微启的双唇、短暂闭眼再睁开、挑衅地直视镜头、空洞却神圣的注视。表演必须始终高级、克制、具杂志编辑感、不随意。全片使用多轮闪光灯剪切与摄影式定格瞬间，如同一组哈苏时装静片被赋予生命。闪光剪切可在正面、侧面、眼部特写、唇部特写、肩颈细节、手触绳索、俯拍、仰拍与镜面反射构图之间快速切换。双生镜像段落中不得使用闪光式定格。

核心概念：曾经束缚她的，最终成为她本身。

场景结构——每场约3秒，共10场。

场景1｜0-3秒——正面特写苏醒
极致美妆特写。黑麻绳框住她的肩、颈与画面边缘。引入第一轮闪光灯剪切，含数个快速镜头：正面特写、眼部特写、唇部特写、侧脸特写。表情递进：冷漠凝视→微启双唇→短暂闭眼再睁开。

场景2｜3-6秒——双生镜像构图
纯黑背景前，两个「她」面对面而立，黑绳缠绕两人的肩、颈与上身。镜头：中景双人、左右侧脸特写、两人对视、一人看镜头另一人看向对方。表情与动作：轻微偏头、眼神流转、短暂停顿、微启双唇、低头再抬眼。不使用闪光式定格。

场景3｜6-9秒——手与黑绳特写
明亮极简背景。绳索不得过于光滑；保留可见纤维、粗粝感、轻微起毛与真实麻质纹理。制造更多股线之间的交织、交叉、打结与层叠压叠。镜头：摊开的手掌、伸展的手指、细绳穿过指缝、俯拍手部构图、指尖与绳结特写。

场景4｜9-12秒——黑色舞台与主装置
纯黑舞台作为核心主场景。她立于中央，身前是巨大、对称、花瓣状或环环相扣的圆形黑绳装置，如黑色花冠或暗黑神圣光环。镜头：极致对称的全身大远景、缓慢推近至中景、仰拍、轻微俯拍。动作：低头、缓缓抬头、轻迈一步向前，随后静立直视镜头。

场景5｜12-15秒——特写回调
回到近景框架，改用高角度，面部微侧，黑绳更贴近面部。镜头：正面、侧面、俯拍、眼部、唇部、手轻触脸旁的绳索。表情：挑衅、空洞、轻蔑。使用更密集的闪光灯剪切。

场景6｜15-18秒——主装置回调
回到黑色舞台装置，同一造型、不换装。镜头：横向轨道移动、透过装置观看、正俯拍、低角度环绕。动作：她半转身，停住，回望镜头。

场景7｜18-21秒——装置艺术空间
切至幽暗的美术馆式装置空间，悬挂大量黑麻绳结构与众多冷金属质感的黑色花朵。她立于中央，缓缓抬起一只手。绳索不得骤然升起；让周围装置有序而微妙地变化，例如花朵缓缓绽放。镜头：全景、仰拍、俯拍、特写，以及装置与光影的变化。整个空间应仿佛在回应她的存在。

场景8｜21-24秒——双生/手部交叉回调
回到双生构图与手部特写，以更快节奏交叉剪辑：两人对视→左侧人物侧脸→手与绳缠绕→右侧人物看镜头→手滑过绳索。可少量使用摄影式剪切，但不得破坏双生段落冷静克制的氛围。

场景9｜24-27秒——终极揭示前的蓄势
快速交叉剪辑：正面特写凝视、主装置全身、眼部特写、唇部特写、手触绳索、装置空间中的她。剪辑显著加快，闪光剪切更加频繁。观众应感到她已从「被缠绕」彻底转变为掌控一切、加冕登场。

场景10｜27-30秒——终极揭示
纯黑背景或深邃虚空，强烈的时尚人像布光与闪光定格瞬间。她完整现身；黑麻绳已化为极具雕塑感的概念高定造型，如可穿戴的装置艺术。硬切镜头包括：正面封面构图、直视镜头的中近景、手触绳索。避免大幅度身体动作。她冷冷抬眼，直视镜头。定格于一个有力的正面杂志封面姿态。

name: 苍白异人·峡谷战巨蟒
desc: 枯瘦苍白的超人类与灰鳞巨蟒在沙漠峡谷手持镜头下缠斗至势均力敌，史诗怪兽特效大片。
original:
A gaunt, pale superhuman monster and a giant gray scar-covered serpent battle to a standstill in a deep desert canyon. Towering dark layered cliffs, a pale sand dune between the rock walls, a dark cave mouth low in the cliff surrounded by bones and hanging strips of cloth, cold mist drifting in the shadows, harsh light cutting across the cliff tops. Handheld camera throughout, violent continuous shake, epic VFX blockbuster scale, anamorphic widescreen lenses, fine film grain.
Shot 1 — The intrusion (0–3s). Handheld macro shifting to wide: extreme close-up of his clawed hand precisely placing a small bone into a row on the sand, shallow depth of field, dust suspended in the rim-light beams — then a sudden eruption behind the focal plane: the serpent bursts through the dune throwing up a wall of sand, its massive shape exploding across the blurred background. Focus racks deep in an instant, he dives sideways — the giant jaws slam into the ground where he was just kneeling, the frame swallowed by dust.
Shot 2 — Trading blows (3–6s). Handheld telephoto from inside the cave mouth, compressed perspective, bones silhouetted at the frame edges. The serpent strikes — he catches its snout and gets shoved backward, boots plowing deep furrows, then wrenches the head down into the dune, sand explodes; the tail whips back in a flat sweep, smashing him clear across the canyon into the rock wall — the rock craters, cracks spidering upward. Both recover in the same instant: he rises from the rubble, the serpent coils into strike position, its shadow drags across the cave mouth, blacking out the lens.
Shot 3 — The reversal (6–8s). Out of the black — violent handheld tilt up, backlit: the serpent deliberately turns, a massive backlit silhouette against burning rim light, and rams its full body weight into the cliff above the cave mouth. The rock face shears away — boulders tumble through the light beams like black meteors — burying the cave mouth, the bones and cloth strips vanish under the rockslide. Cut to his face: dust streaming off his shoulders, the light dying out in his milky-white eyes, shock hardening into something cold.
Shot 4 — The outburst (8–11s). Ground-level handheld whipping sideways at full speed — a pale blur of afterimages, his strides blasting sand at the lens, rock walls smearing into motion trails — as he leaps, the camera slams vertically down: both claws pin the serpent's snout into the rockfall, the shockwave splits the canyon floor, cracks racing forward under the lens, the horizon lurching into a dutch angle. But the serpent's body has already coiled around him at the moment of impact — it tightens, rips him away and hurls him through a stone pillar, the pillar bursting into rubble.
Shot 5 — Mutual damage (11–13s). Tight, vicious handheld, the two faces alternating inches apart: he bursts out of the ruins and collides head-on with a mid-air strike — his claws tear a long gash through the scales of the serpent's snout, and in the same instant the tail hammers into his ribs. Both blows land simultaneously, both bodies get thrown apart in twin explosions of sand and stone, his silhouette reflected in the serpent's wet, rolling eyeball, dust strobing in the rim light.
Shot 6 — The standoff (13–15s). Handheld wide through the falling dust, backlit: the two face off across the cratered battlefield — he's down on one knee, bleeding, one arm hanging limp, breathing hard; the serpent sways in a loose coil, the black gash on its snout seeping blood, its tongue tasting the dust. A long pause inside the god-ray light columns, neither one moves. Then — on the same breath — he straightens up, the serpent lowers its hood, the frame holds on the two of them evenly matched, and focus pulls to the foreground: a small bone, half-buried in the sand, lying still between them.
Sound: quiet wind and the soft click of bones being set in a row, then the eruption shockwave, massive booming impacts as blows land, scales cracking and rock collapsing, one hoarse roar from him at the reversal, the serpent's bellow shifting into a wary hiss, and at the end — two kinds of breathing, his ragged gasps and its deep slow hiss, as the dust settles.
Style: epic cinematic VFX blockbuster, big-budget monster movie, harsh rim sunlight against cold canyon shadows, volumetric god rays in the dust, shallow depth-of-field foreground language with rack-focus accents, backlit silhouettes, motion blur on strikes and sprints, bleached cold low-saturation film grade. No text, no logos, no watermark, no slow motion, no smooth stabilized camera moves, no static tripod shots.
zh:
一具枯瘦苍白的超人类怪物与一条遍体灰色伤疤的巨蟒，在幽深的沙漠峡谷中缠斗至势均力敌。高耸的深色层状峭壁，岩壁之间一道苍白沙丘，崖底低处一个被骸骨与悬挂布条环绕的幽暗洞口，冷雾在阴影中飘移，刺目的光线切过崖顶。全程手持摄影，剧烈持续晃动，史诗级特效大片规格，变形宽银幕镜头，细腻胶片颗粒。

镜头1——闯入（0-3秒）。手持微距转广角：特写他带爪的手将一根小骨头精准摆进沙地上的一排，浅景深，尘埃悬浮在轮廓光束中——随后焦平面之后骤然爆发：巨蟒破丘而出，掀起一面沙墙，庞大身躯在模糊的背景中炸开。焦点瞬间拉向纵深，他侧身扑闪——巨颚轰然砸进他刚才跪坐的地面，画面被尘沙吞没。

镜头2——互换重击（3-6秒）。洞口内手持长焦，压缩透视，骸骨在画框边缘成剪影。巨蟒袭来——他扣住蛇吻被推得连连后退，靴子犁出深沟，随即将蛇头狠狠拧砸进沙丘，沙尘爆开；蛇尾横扫回击，将他整个抽飞横越峡谷撞上岩壁——岩壁凹陷成坑，裂纹向上蔓延。两者同一瞬间恢复：他从瓦砾中站起，巨蟒盘身蓄势，蛇影拖过洞口，黑幕遮没镜头。

镜头3——逆转（6-8秒）。从黑幕中——手持猛烈上摇，逆光：巨蟒刻意转身，在灼烧般的轮廓光前呈现庞大逆光剪影，以全身重量撞向洞口上方的峭壁。岩面整片剪切崩落——巨石如黑色流星般滚过光束——掩埋洞口，骸骨与布条消失在岩崩之下。切至他的脸：尘土从肩头流泻，乳白双眼中的光渐渐熄灭，震惊凝固成冰冷之物。

镜头4——爆发（8-11秒）。地面手持全速横甩——一道苍白的残影模糊，他的步伐将沙子轰向镜头，岩壁拖成运动轨迹——他跃起时，镜头垂直下砸：双爪将蛇吻钉进岩堆，冲击波劈开谷底，裂缝在镜头下方疾驰向前，地平线倾成荷兰角。但巨蟒躯体已在撞击瞬间缠上他——收紧、将他撕离，掼穿一根石柱，石柱爆成碎砾。

镜头5——两败俱伤（11-13秒）。逼近而凶狠的手持，两张脸在咫尺间交替：他冲出废墟与半空袭来的一击迎面相撞——利爪在蛇吻鳞甲上撕开一道长口，同一瞬间蛇尾重锤砸进他的肋部。双击同时命中，两具身躯在沙石的孪生爆炸中被抛开，他的剪影倒映在巨蟒湿润转动的眼球里，尘埃在轮廓光中频闪。

镜头6——对峙（13-15秒）。手持广角穿过落尘，逆光：两者隔着弹坑遍布的战场对峙——他单膝跪地，流着血，一条手臂无力垂下，喘息粗重；巨蟒松盘着身躯摇晃，蛇吻上的黑色裂口渗血，信子舔着尘土。神迹光柱中长久的停顿，谁都不动。然后——同一次呼吸间——他直起身，巨蟒收落颈兜，画面停在势均力敌的两者身上，焦点拉向前景：一根小骨头半埋沙中，静静躺在两者之间。

声音：安静的风声与骨头逐一排列的轻响，然后是爆发冲击波、重击命中的巨大轰响、鳞甲开裂与岩石崩塌、逆转时他一声嘶哑咆哮、巨蟒的怒吼转为警惕的嘶鸣，结尾——两种呼吸，他破碎的喘息与它深缓的嘶声，随尘埃落定。

风格：史诗级电影特效大片、大制作怪兽电影、刺目轮廓阳光对冷峡谷阴影、尘埃中的体积神迹光、浅景深前景语言与拉焦重音、逆光剪影、打击与冲刺的运动模糊、漂白冷调低饱和胶片调色。无文字、无标志、无水印、无慢动作、无平滑增稳运镜、无固定三脚架镜头。

name: 千禧糖果双人女团MV
desc: 双人女团在糖果色三景棚内完成全同步编舞与卡拍硬切，1999年音乐电视质感的现代级MV。
original:
[SCENE] A two-girl pop duo shooting a retro millennium-style MV: candy-colored studio sets, perfectly synchronized gesture choreography, beat-matched hard cuts and fast punch zooms — the texture of 1999 music television, delivered at modern production quality.
[ACTIVE REFERENCES]
@image1: female singer in her twenties, long straight pink hair with gold hair clips, small nose ring, small beauty mark on her cheek, white printed crop top, silver chain necklace, chain belt, light-blue washed baggy jeans, off-white platform sneakers. Playful and confident. 100% match to the reference image.
@image2: female singer in her twenties, long straight black hair with silver hair clips, light blue eyes with silver glitter eyeshadow, red cord necklace with a ruby pendant, gray raglan short-sleeve tee with a gray jacket draped over it, dark gray pleated skirt with a bow, gray long socks, black platform shoes. Cool and commanding. 100% match to the reference image.
[SET MAP] Three practical studio sets, each about 4 meters deep, facing camera:
Set A — bubblegum-pink seamless cyc, glossy reflective floor, two rows of round studio bulbs on the back wall.
Set B — cobalt-blue seamless cyc, one hard white spotlight circle on the floor.
Set C — floor-to-ceiling silver rain-curtain wall, mirror floor.
[FIRST FRAME & BLOCKING] The first visible frame already contains both girls, in Set A: @image1 at x40% frame left, @image2 at x60% frame right, medium-shot depth, 0.5m apart, bodies square to camera, eyes locked on the lens, frozen in a mirrored opening pose — inner hand on hip, outer arm raised. No empty opening shot, no delayed entrance.
[FORMAT] Controlled multi-shot sequence, fourteen segments, every hard cut landing exactly on a musical downbeat. Real-time motion.
[LENS NOTES] Fisheye = true fisheye wide, 1.5m from subject, visible barrel distortion at the frame edges, deliberate 1999 MV lens language; 47° = standard angle, natural proportions; 29° = medium portrait, background slightly compressed; 18° = telephoto close-up, melted bokeh. Locked within each segment, no drift.
[ACTION TIMELINE]
0.0–2.0s Set A, fisheye low angle: both girls hit the frozen mirrored pose on the first beat, then bounce in sync with every beat, camera slowly pushes in 10%.
2.0s hard cut. 2.0–4.0s Set B, 29°: @image2 solo inside the spotlight circle at x50%, sharp point-at-camera gesture choreography, two fast punch zooms exactly on the downbeats.
4.0s hard cut. 4.0–6.0s Set C, 47°: @image1 whips her pink hair through a full arc, then strides toward camera, camera pulls back at matching speed, rain curtain shimmering, chain belt swinging.
6.0s hard cut. 6.0–8.0s Set A, fisheye at knee height: synchronized duo step combo — side steps, shoulder pops, mirrored arm waves, @image1 left, @image2 right, spacing locked at 0.5m.
8.0s hard cut. 8.0–10.0s Set B, 18° two-shot close-up: both faces cheek to cheek filling the frame, @image1 left, @image2 right, soft wind lifting pink and black strands, glossy makeup, confident smiles, heads tilting toward each other in sync with the beat.
10.0s hard cut. 10.0–12.0s Set B, 29°: @image1 solo, wrist rolls and fingers pointing at the lens, one zoom punch landing on the downbeat.
12.0s hard cut. 12.0–14.0s Set C, 47°: @image2 strides forward with a cold stare into the lens, black hair swinging with every step, camera pulls back at matching speed.
14.0s hard cut. 14.0–18.0s Set A, 47° full body: chorus dance core — four counts of fully synchronized choreography: arm waves, fast spin, full-body groove, sharp freeze at the end; they cross positions and return, @image1 left, @image2 right, lock restored.
18.0s hard cut. 18.0–20.0s Set C, 18°: @image2 face close-up, silver rain strands blurred into bokeh sparkles, she blinks on the beat, corner of her mouth lifting.
20.0s hard cut. 20.0–22.0s Set A, 18°: @image1 face close-up, background bulbs melting into creamy bokeh, wind in her hair, eyes locked on the lens.
22.0s hard cut. 22.0–24.0s Set B, fisheye: the duo spins one full mirrored rotation in place, then freezes simultaneously, skirt and hair settling with a delay.
24.0s hard cut. 24.0–26.0s Set C, 47°: side by side, arms swinging in sync as they walk toward camera, the mirror floor carrying their reflections.
26.0s hard cut. 26.0–28.0s Set A, fisheye low angle: both bounce to the beat, the glossy floor stretching in the distortion.
28.0s hard cut. 28.0–30.0s Set A, 47°: back-to-back final pose freeze, camera zooms out fast to full body, landing exactly on the final downbeat, one bright camera-flash white-out sweeping across the last frame.
[PHYSICS] Choreography with real weight: heels striking the floor, weight shifts, shoulder isolations with follow-through. Hair whips with visible lag and settles naturally. Chain belt and necklaces swing on the beat points. The rain curtain ripples from body movement. The glossy floor returns soft, realistic reflections.
[LIGHTING] High-key even studio lighting on every set: large soft frontal key, bright clean exposure, high skin sheen; Set A bulb rows form a back rim light with soft flare bleeding into the lens; Set B spotlight casts a crisp circular pool; Set C hundreds of specular highlights across the rain strands. Bright, candy-like, camera-ready — deliberately flat 1999 TV-studio lighting.
[AUDIO] Original Y2K bubblegum dance track, instrumental only, 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, bright syncopated synths, faint tape hiss underneath. Every hard cut lands exactly on a downbeat. No vocals anywhere in the video; both girls perform with closed lips, pushing all the energy through expressions and choreography.
[POSITIVE LOCK] Both faces and identities stay 100% locked to the reference images in every segment, including close-ups. Outfits remain exactly as referenced across all three sets. Only these two girls appear in the entire video. In every duo segment @image1 stays frame left, @image2 stays frame right. Set geography, spacing and screen direction stay consistent within each segment.
[STYLE] The 1999 broadcast look shot at modern production quality: a broadcast-videotape master texture layered over a high-detail image — softly blooming highlights, slight chroma bleed on hard color edges, fine analog tape grain, faint interlace flicker on fast motion; a high-saturation candy palette of bubblegum pink, electric cobalt and chrome silver; millennium-era music-television punch-zoom editing energy, with contemporary sharpness underneath.
zh:
【场景】双人女子流行组合拍摄千禧复古风MV：糖果色摄影棚布景、完全同步的手势编舞、卡节拍硬切与快速冲击变焦——1999年音乐电视的质感，以现代制作水准呈现。
【生效参考】
@图1：二十多岁女歌手，粉色长直发配金色发夹，小鼻环，脸颊有小美人痣，白色印花短上衣，银色链条项链，链条腰带，浅蓝水洗宽松牛仔裤，米白厚底运动鞋。俏皮自信。与参考图100%一致。
@图2：二十多岁女歌手，黑色长直发配银色发夹，浅蓝色眼睛配银色亮片眼影，红绳红宝石吊坠项链，灰色插肩短袖T恤外搭披着的灰夹克，深灰百褶裙配蝴蝶结，灰色长袜，黑色厚底鞋。冷酷有压场感。与参考图100%一致。
【布景地图】三个实景摄影棚，每个纵深约4米，面向镜头：
布景A——泡泡糖粉无缝背景墙，光面反射地板，后墙两排圆形摄影棚灯泡。
布景B——钴蓝无缝背景墙，地面一个硬白聚光圈。
布景C——落地银色雨帘墙，镜面地板。
【首帧与走位】第一可见帧即包含两位女孩，位于布景A：@图1在画面左侧x40%，@图2在画面右侧x60%，中景景深，间距0.5米，身体正对镜头，眼睛锁定镜头，定格于镜像开场姿势——内侧手叉腰，外侧手臂高举。无空镜开场，无延迟入场。
【格式】受控多镜头序列，十四段，每次硬切精确落在音乐重拍上。实时动态。
【镜头注记】鱼眼=真鱼眼广角，距主体1.5米，画框边缘可见桶形畸变，刻意的1999年MV镜头语言；47°=标准视角，自然比例；29°=中焦人像，背景轻微压缩；18°=长焦特写，融化焦外。每段内锁定，不漂移。
【动作时间轴】
0.0-2.0秒 布景A，鱼眼低角度：两人在第一拍击中定格镜像姿势，随后随每一拍同步弹跳，镜头缓推10%。
2.0秒硬切。2.0-4.0秒 布景B，29°：@图2在聚光圈内x50%独舞，凌厉的指向镜头手势编舞，两次快速冲击变焦精确落在重拍上。
4.0秒硬切。4.0-6.0秒 布景C，47°：@图1甩动粉发划出完整弧线，随后大步走向镜头，镜头以匹配速度后拉，雨帘闪烁，链条腰带摆动。
6.0秒硬切。6.0-8.0秒 布景A，膝盖高度鱼眼：同步双人舞步组合——侧步、耸肩、镜像手臂波浪，@图1在左，@图2在右，间距锁定0.5米。
8.0秒硬切。8.0-10.0秒 布景B，18°双人特写：两张脸颊贴颊填满画面，@图1左@图2右，柔风吹起粉黑发丝，光泽妆效，自信微笑，头部随节拍同步相互倾靠。
10.0秒硬切。10.0-12.0秒 布景B，29°：@图1独舞，手腕翻转与手指指向镜头，一次变焦冲击落在重拍上。
12.0秒硬切。12.0-14.0秒 布景C，47°：@图2冷眼直视镜头大步向前，黑发随步伐摆动，镜头以匹配速度后拉。
14.0秒硬切。14.0-18.0秒 布景A，47°全身：副歌舞蹈核心——四个八拍完全同步的编舞：手臂波浪、快速旋转、全身律动、末尾利落定格；两人交叉换位再返回，@图1左@图2右，位置锁定恢复。
18.0秒硬切。18.0-20.0秒 布景C，18°：@图2面部特写，银色雨丝虚化为焦外闪点，她随节拍眨眼，嘴角上扬。
20.0秒硬切。20.0-22.0秒 布景A，18°：@图1面部特写，背景灯泡融成奶油焦外，风拂发丝，双眼锁定镜头。
22.0秒硬切。22.0-24.0秒 布景B，鱼眼：两人原地完成一整圈镜像旋转，随后同时定格，裙摆与头发延迟落定。
24.0秒硬切。24.0-26.0秒 布景C，47°：并肩同步摆臂走向镜头，镜面地板承载倒影。
26.0秒硬切。26.0-28.0秒 布景A，鱼眼低角度：两人随节拍弹跳，光面地板在畸变中延展。
28.0秒硬切。28.0-30.0秒 布景A，47°：背靠背最终姿势定格，镜头快速拉远至全身，精确落在最后一个重拍上，一道明亮的闪光灯白闪扫过最后一帧。
【物理】有真实重量的编舞：脚跟击地、重心转移、带跟随惯性的肩部隔离动作。甩发有可见滞后并自然落定。链条腰带与项链在节拍点上摆动。雨帘因身体运动泛起涟漪。光面地板返回柔和真实的倒影。
【灯光】每个布景均为高调均匀棚拍布光：大面积柔光正面主光、明亮干净的曝光、高皮肤光泽；布景A灯泡排形成背部轮廓光并有柔和眩光渗入镜头；布景B聚光灯投下清晰圆形光池；布景C雨丝上数百个镜面高光。明亮、糖果般、随时可拍——刻意的1999年电视演播室平光。
【音频】原创Y2K泡泡糖舞曲，纯伴奏，120 BPM，四四拍底鼓，明亮切分合成器，底层隐约磁带底噪。每次硬切精确落在重拍上。全片无人声；两位女孩闭唇表演，全部能量通过表情与编舞释放。
【正向锁定】所有段落（含特写）中两人的脸与身份100%锁定参考图。三个布景中服装完全保持参考原样。全片只出现这两位女孩。所有双人段落@图1保持画左，@图2保持画右。每段内布景地理、间距与画面方向保持一致。
【风格】以现代制作水准呈现的1999年播出画质：广播录像带母带质感叠加高细节画面——柔和溢光的高光、硬色边的轻微色度渗色、细腻模拟磁带颗粒、快速运动上隐约的隔行闪烁；泡泡糖粉、电光钴蓝与铬银的高饱和糖果配色；千禧年代音乐电视的冲击变焦剪辑能量，底层保持当代锐度。

name: 变形者·画室对谈
desc: 画室对坐间变形者随口切换游戏英雄、警察、机器人诸形态，终以复制男主并留下空椅倒影收场。
original:
30-second uncanny romantic sci-fi horror, 4K, 21:9, high bitrate. Use the attached image as the absolute reference for THE SHAPESHIFTER'S initial form: adult woman, soft oval face, perfectly straight chestnut hair with center part, mirrored black marbled glasses, white forehead device with a short antenna, yellow star clip, pale-pink jacket and beige knitted top. Preserve this form whenever she returns to it.

One continuous daytime workshop: warm window light, cluttered drawing desk and two chairs facing each other. Clear air with no smoke, mist, dust or particles. Opposite her sits an adult man in a dark charcoal sweater. He begins curious and attracted, then gradually becomes disturbed. Transformations happen physically in the same chair—no teleportation or background changes.

SHOT 1 — 0–4s, 75mm over the man's shoulder. She leans forward with a restrained smile. Her mirrored lenses reflect his nervous hands, but her reflection already has his face. He has not noticed.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"You keep staring."

MAN, embarrassed:
"Sorry. I'm trying to figure you out."

Her smile widens a millimeter too far.

SHOT 2 — 4–10s, locked 50mm profile two-shot. She circles one finger beside her face.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"Want me to be the hero from your favorite game?"

In half a second, her skin, hair and clothing fold into an original armored game heroine: hard-jawed face, blue-steel armor, dramatic scar. No copyrighted character. She gives him a cocky wink, then instantly snaps back.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"Or a cop?"

Her pink jacket contracts into a dark police uniform; her posture straightens and her voice drops. She leans closer as if questioning him:

SHAPESHIFTER:
"You've been very suspicious."

The man laughs genuinely—then notices she has copied the exact rhythm of his laugh.

SHOT 3 — 10–16s, 35mm slow orbit around the table. Without leaving her chair, she transforms every time the camera passes behind the man's shoulder.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"Furry?"

She becomes an elegant feline humanoid with velvet ears, whiskers and a long tail curling around the chair. Her original smile remains unnaturally unchanged.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"I can be a robot."

Her face closes into seamless porcelain-metal plates; the glasses become black optical sensors. She reaches toward his cheek with articulated fingers, stopping one centimeter away.

ROBOT FORM, softly:
"Would that make this easier?"

SHOT 4 — 16–21s, 85mm on the man. His attraction drains slowly: smile fades, throat tightens, shoulders pull inward. He forces one more laugh but it breaks halfway.

MAN:
"Do you ever stop performing?"

All mechanical sound stops.

SHOT 5 — 21–26s, 40mm symmetrical two-shot that slowly becomes asymmetrical as she shifts closer. She returns to her initial pink-clad form, but removes the glasses. Her eyes are completely ordinary—and genuinely hurt.

SHAPESHIFTER:
"Only when nobody's looking."

MAN, gentler:
"What do you look like then?"

She searches his face as if the question has wounded her.

SHOT 6 — 26–30s, 65mm slow push from behind her. Her features transform gradually into an exact copy of the man: his eyes, mouth, nervous posture and charcoal sweater. The copy takes his unfinished expression and completes it with a calm smile.

SHAPESHIFTER, in his voice:
"I was hoping you could show me."

The real man stops breathing. In the dark lenses lying on the table, his chair is reflected as empty.

CUT TO BLACK.

Deep natural acting: imperfect pauses, interrupted laughter, shifting eye contact and controlled breathing. Fast transformations contrast with slow emotional realization. No gore, body tearing, frantic montage or spatial discontinuity.
zh:
30秒诡异浪漫科幻惊悚，4K，21:9，高码率。以所附图片作为「变形者」初始形态的绝对参考：成年女性，柔和鹅蛋脸，中分完全笔直的栗色长发，镜面黑色大理石纹眼镜，额前带短天线的白色装置，黄色星星发夹，浅粉外套与米色针织上衣。每次她变回该形态时都须保持一致。

单一连续的白天工作室场景：温暖窗光，杂乱的绘图桌与两把相对的椅子。空气清澈，无烟、无雾、无尘、无颗粒。她对面坐着一位穿深炭灰毛衣的成年男子。他起初好奇而着迷，随后逐渐不安。所有变形都在同一把椅子上以实体方式发生——无瞬移、无背景变化。

镜头1——0-4秒，75mm过男子肩膀。她带着克制的微笑前倾。她的镜面镜片映出他紧张的双手，但镜中她的倒影已经是他的脸。他尚未察觉。

变形者：
「你一直在盯着我看。」

男子，尴尬：
「抱歉。我在试着看懂你。」

她的微笑扩大了多出一毫米的弧度。

镜头2——4-10秒，锁定50mm侧面双人镜头。她在脸旁绕了一圈手指。

变形者：
「要我变成你最爱游戏里的主角吗？」

半秒内，她的皮肤、头发与衣服折叠成一位原创盔甲游戏女英雄：硬朗下颌、蓝钢盔甲、夸张伤疤。不使用任何版权角色。她俏皮地眨眼，随即瞬间弹回原形。

变形者：
「还是变个警察？」

粉色外套收缩成深色警服；她坐姿挺直，声音压低。她像审讯般凑近：

变形者：
「你最近非常可疑。」

男子由衷大笑——随即发现她复制了他笑声的精确节奏。

镜头3——10-16秒，35mm绕桌缓慢环绕。她不离开椅子，每当镜头经过男子肩后就完成一次变形。

变形者：
「兽人形态？」

她变成优雅的猫科类人生物：天鹅绒耳朵、胡须、缠绕椅背的长尾。她原本的微笑保持着不自然的不变。

变形者：
「我也可以是机器人。」

她的面孔闭合成无缝的瓷金属板；眼镜化为黑色光学传感器。她伸出关节分明的手指探向他的脸颊，在一厘米处停住。

机器人形态，轻声：
「这样会让一切更容易吗？」

镜头4——16-21秒，85mm对准男子。他的迷恋缓缓流失：笑容褪去，喉头收紧，双肩内收。他勉强再挤出一声笑，笑到一半断裂。

男子：
「你有停止表演的时候吗？」

所有机械声戛然而止。

镜头5——21-26秒，40mm对称双人镜头，随她凑近而缓缓失衡。她变回最初的粉衣形态，但摘下了眼镜。她的眼睛完全普通——并且真切地受了伤。

变形者：
「只有没人看的时候。」

男子，语气放柔：
「那时候你是什么样子？」

她审视他的脸，仿佛这个问题伤到了她。

镜头6——26-30秒，65mm从她身后缓推。她的五官逐渐变形为男子的精确复制：他的眼睛、嘴、紧张的姿态与炭灰毛衣。复制体接过他未完成的表情，用一个平静的微笑将其完成。

变形者，用他的声音：
「我正希望你能演给我看。」

真正的男子停止了呼吸。桌上放着的黑色镜片里，他的椅子映出的是空的。

切至黑场。

深度自然表演：不完美的停顿、被打断的笑声、游移的眼神接触与克制的呼吸。快速变形与缓慢的情感领悟形成对比。无血腥、无躯体撕裂、无狂乱蒙太奇、无空间不连续。

name: 石堡密谋·烛火三人对峙
desc: 夜晚城堡烛光下三名密谋者低语夺国，情绪从耳语层层升级至拍案而起的多镜头对话戏。
original:
SCENE BACKGROUND
A continuous 30-second multi-shot dramatic dialogue scene. Night, inside a stone castle hall. Three conspirators sit around a heavy dark table with a single lit candle on it: a woman on the left in right-facing profile, a long-haired man in black at the center facing the camera, a young man on the right in left-facing profile. Behind them, tall pointed-arch leaded-glass windows glow with cold moonlight. They are plotting to seize the kingdom of Anas from the current king, Yernat. The scene starts exactly from the provided first frame. Tension escalates step by step from a whispered proposal to an eruption: the man in the center slams the table and rises.
first frame and visual baseline: composition, the positions of all three characters, their appearance and wardrobe, the candle position, the arched windows and the lighting atmosphere all match this reference 100%. Ignore any compression noise in the reference.
FIRST FRAME & SPATIAL LAYOUT
Frame one matches @image1 exactly: the candle flame sits low-center of frame, the center man faces the camera behind the candle, the woman is at the left edge in right-facing profile, the young man at the right edge in left-facing profile, two pointed-arch windows glowing blue behind the center man. The woman and the young man face each other across the table; the center man sits centered on the far side. This spatial relationship is locked for the entire video — the camera never crosses the axis between the woman (left) and the young man (right).
PICTURE MODE
Multi-shot cinematic sequence, 2.39:1, modern digital cinema feel, anamorphic widescreen lens character: oval-stretched bokeh, slight edge barrel distortion and edge chromatic aberration, sharp clean center, restrained highlights, no lens flares, no horizontal light streaks, no floating light blobs.
OPTICS
The wide master sits at roughly a 65° field of view; dialogue close-ups at roughly 47°, close enough that eyes, lips, jaw and throat read clearly; the rising climax at roughly 55°. Focus always stays on the speaking or reacting face; backgrounds fall into soft anamorphic bokeh.
SHOT & ACTION TIMELINE
[SHOT 1 — 0.0–4.5s — wide master, the proposal]
Camera on the near side of the table, at seated eye level, static, composition identical to the first frame, all three and the candle in frame. A brief silence: the candle flame trembles, the woman's chest rises with a held breath. She leans a few centimeters toward the flame and lowers her voice — a whisper carrying years of suppressed hatred, each word released through her teeth:
WOMAN (quiet, restrained, hatred burning under the whisper, in English): "Anas is weakening. Yernat has lost the north — and he knows it."
The instant she speaks, both men come alive: the center man slowly shifts his weight onto the table, elbows sliding forward, head tilting slightly toward her, eyes narrowing; the young man's fingers curl in on the tabletop, he glances first at the center man, then back to the woman, his throat moves once, his eyes widening by a millimeter.
[SHOT 2 — 4.5–10.0s — close-up on the woman, over-the-shoulder reverse]
Cut to a 47° close-up of the woman, shot over the blurred dark shoulder of the young man in the right foreground — his shoulder rises and falls slightly with his breathing and slowly turns a few degrees toward her as she speaks. Her face is half firelight, half shadow. Her eyes act the entire scene as she talks: pupils dilating slightly, lower eyelids tightening with resolve, gaze nailed to the face across from her without moving — not looking, pressing. On the word "now" her chin lifts a few millimeters, a flash of almost fanatical certainty crosses her eyes, immediately pushed back down by composure:
WOMAN (cold certainty, each word landing like a falling stone, a tremor of excitement in the tail of the line, in English): "If we march on the capital now, the cities will open their gates to us themselves."
Her eyes are natural human eyes, the candle flame present only as a tiny reflected highlight on the lower rim of her pupils; her hands stay folded, knuckles slowly whitening.
[SHOT 3 — 10.0–15.5s — reverse close-up on the young man]
Same-side-of-axis reverse: a 47° close-up of the young man, shot over the blurred dark shoulder of the woman in the left foreground, his profile turned toward her, the back of his head rimmed in moonlight. The woman's shoulder in the foreground stays steady, moving only with her breath. Fear arrives in his eyes first: two quick blinks, his gaze fleeing between her face, the candle flame and the tabletop and being dragged back, a thin film of wet light rising along his lower eyelids — no tears falling, just the moisture of fear. He shakes his head once as if to throw the thought off, his Adam's apple rolls in a swallow, his jaw tightens:
YOUNG MAN (voice tight, cracking once mid-sentence, the second half almost pleading, in English): "And if we're wrong? Yernat will burn our homes with us inside them."
On the last word his breath makes the candle flame sway gently, and his hand on the table pulls half a palm's width back toward himself involuntarily.
[SHOT 4 — 15.5–20.0s — close-up on the center man, the fuse burning]
Cut to a 47° frontal close-up of the center man, candlelight warming his face softly from below, the arched windows glowing blue behind him. He has not spoken yet. Off-screen, the woman presses him quietly for an answer; the young man's rapid breathing is audible on the other side. Anger ignites in his eyes by degrees: his gaze moves first to her on the left — pupils tightening; then to him on the right — upper eyelids sinking into a contemptuous half-close; then his gaze drops to the candle flame and locks, eyeballs trembling within a tiny range, like a beast being held down. His nostrils flare on the inhale, the masseter swells along his jaw, lower eyelids tighten, his head shakes half a slow shake, his fingers slowly close into a fist on the table, the ring on his finger catching the candlelight. His gaze freezes, pupils holding only the candle's tiny natural reflection.
[SHOT 5 — 20.0–25.0s — the eruption, wide]
Cut back to the wide master, camera static, at seated eye level. The center man's fist comes down on the table — a heavy impact, the candle jumps, the flame whips violently and nearly goes out, hot wax spatters, shadows lurch hard across all three faces. In the same motion he pushes himself up off the table, his chair scraping backward and toppling onto the stone floor, his body rising like a black tower over the recovering flame, eyes wide, brow bone pressed low:
CENTER MAN (a roar detonating from the chest, followed by one sharp gasp of breath, in English): "Enough!"
The woman flinches hard, one hand instinctively pressing the table to steady herself, but her gaze does not retreat — her eyes open wider to meet his, chin lifting toward him, as if saying "go on, then"; the young man's whole upper body recoils, shoulders hunching, one hand seizing the table edge, his widened eyes darting fast between the standing man and the woman, his breathing visibly quickening.
[SHOT 6 — 25.0–30.0s — low-angle closing hook]
Cut to a low camera position on the near side, slightly above the tabletop, shooting up past the recovering candle flame at the standing center man, his face lit softly by the firelight from below, the two pointed-arch windows in cold blue on either side of his silhouette. Both fists planted on the table, he leans down over the flame toward the other two. The rage recedes back into his eyes and becomes something more frightening — a calm, no-longer-wavering resolve: upper eyelids lowered halfway, his gaze traveling slowly from her to him, pausing one beat on each face, letting each of them be seen into. He speaks, his voice so low it almost crawls along the tabletop, a suffocating pause held between the words:
CENTER MAN (low, word by word, terrifyingly calm, the last four words almost breath, in English): "The kingdom of Anas will be ours before the first snow. Or we will not be at all."
At the frame edges, the woman slowly straightens, fear and triumph lighting in her eyes at once, an almost imperceptible nod; the young man lowers his gaze, swallows once, then raises his eyes again — changed: the fear is still there, but a decision has settled on top of it. The candle flame steadies between his fists. Hold on his eyes for two beats. End frame.
PERFORMANCE
All acting is physical and specific, the eyes are the primary instrument: pupils dilating and tightening, eyelid heights shifting, blink-rate changes, gazes fleeing and nailing down, the wet shine of the lower eyelids in fear, the micro-tremor of the eyeballs in rage — all real human eye-muscle performance, never exaggerated, never cartoonish. The vocal performance is equally specific: hatred under a whisper, a voice crack, pleading, a chest roar, breath-voice — every line has a clear emotional arc, never flat delivery. Listeners never freeze: every line triggers visible, line-driven physical and eye reactions in the other two. Real eyelines connect all three. Only these three voices, one person speaking at a time, no overlaps.
PHYSICS
The candle flame reacts to every event: trembling with breath, whipping violently on the fist slam, wax spattering, the smoke line torn sideways, then recovering to steady. The fist slam carries real mass — the tabletop shudders, objects on it rattle. The chair topples with weight and settles on the stone. Clothing creases and shifts with every lean; the rise to standing has wind-up, drive and follow-through, hair and collar settling one beat after the body stops.
LIGHTING
Locked for the whole scene: 1900K candlelight as the key on all faces — warm, soft, asymmetrical underlight; 7500K cold moonlight through the pointed-arch windows rims shoulders and hair, keeping the stone hall in deep, transparent blue shadow. In Shot 5, as the flame whips, the entire warm layer of the image dips and recovers with it, while the blue moonlight layer stays constant. Faces stay readable in every shot, with enough light on the eyes for the eye performance to read clearly. All eyes are natural human eyes: the highlights in them are only the physical reflection of the candle flame, tiny and non-glowing; the wet shine of fear is only the natural reflection of the tear film. The eyes themselves do not glow, do not shine, have no internal light source.
AUDIO
NO MUSIC. SFX ONLY — diegetic sound and live audio throughout. No score, no soundtrack, no background music of any kind. English dialogue exactly as scripted, one voice at a time, emotional delivery matching the script notes: whisper, voice crack, roar, breath-voice. The ambience of a great stone hall: wind tapping the leaded glass, the candle flame hissing, cloth rustling, breathing — the breathing growing audibly clearer as the tension escalates. Shot 5: the heavy thud of a fist on a wooden table with the light rattle of objects on it, chair legs scraping and toppling onto stone, the whoosh of the whipping flame. Shot 6: near-silence under his final line — only the candle, the wind and three people breathing.
STYLE
Realistic modern digital cinema, low-key old-master painterly palette: amber candlelight against steel-blue moonlight, deep transparent shadows preserving the stone texture, clean noise-free image, wide dynamic range, natural skin texture, restrained refined grading.
QUALITY
Faces and eyes sharp and readable in every close-up, stable pacing, natural cinematic motion blur only on the table slam and the rise, no ghosting, no duplicated limbs, no flicker. Character identities, wardrobe and the set stay 100% consistent with @image1 across all shots.
POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
Only three people, one candle and the pointed-arch windows in frame. The woman stays frame-left, the young man frame-right, the center man in the middle — screen direction and the eyeline axis hold across every cut. Light comes only from the candle and the moonlight. All eyes stay natural and realistic, every eye performance is human eye-muscle movement, no glow effects of any kind. Dialogue is strictly the scripted English lines, no improvisation, no subtitles, no voice-over.
zh:
场景背景
一段连续30秒的多镜头戏剧对话场景。夜晚，石砌城堡大厅内。三名密谋者围坐在一张摆着一支点燃蜡烛的厚重深色桌旁：左侧女子呈朝右侧脸，中央黑衣长发男子面向镜头，右侧年轻男子呈朝左侧脸。他们身后，高耸的尖拱铅条玻璃窗透着冷月光。他们正密谋从现任国王耶尔纳特手中夺取阿纳斯王国。场景从所给首帧精确开始。张力从耳语提案逐级升至爆发：中央男子拍案而起。
首帧与视觉基线：构图、三人位置、外貌与服装、蜡烛位置、尖拱窗与光照氛围均与该参考100%一致。忽略参考中的任何压缩噪点。
首帧与空间布局
第一帧与@图1完全一致：烛焰位于画面中下方，中央男子在烛后面向镜头，女子在左缘呈朝右侧脸，年轻男子在右缘呈朝左侧脸，中央男子身后两扇泛蓝光的尖拱窗。女子与年轻男子隔桌相对；中央男子坐在桌对面正中。该空间关系全片锁定——摄影机永不越过女子（左）与年轻男子（右）之间的轴线。
画面模式
多镜头电影序列，2.39:1，现代数字电影感，变形宽银幕镜头特性：椭圆拉伸焦外、轻微边缘桶形畸变与边缘色差、中心锐利干净、克制的高光、无镜头眩光、无横向光条、无漂浮光斑。
光学
广角主镜头约65°视场；对话特写约47°，近到能清晰读出眼睛、嘴唇、下颌与喉部；起身高潮约55°。焦点始终保持在说话或反应的面孔上；背景落入柔和的变形焦外。
镜头与动作时间轴
【镜头1——0.0-4.5秒——广角主镜头，提案】
摄影机位于桌近侧，坐姿视线高度，静止，构图与首帧相同，三人与蜡烛均在画内。短暂沉默：烛焰颤动，女子胸口因屏息而起伏。她朝火焰倾身几厘米，压低声音——带着多年压抑仇恨的耳语，每个字都从齿间挤出：
女子（安静、克制、耳语下燃烧着仇恨，英语）："阿纳斯正在衰弱。耶尔纳特丢了北境——他自己也清楚。"
她开口的一瞬，两名男子同时被激活：中央男子缓缓将重心压上桌面，手肘前滑，头微微偏向她，眼睛眯起；年轻男子的手指在桌面蜷起，先瞥向中央男子再看回女子，喉结滚动一次，双眼睁大一毫米。
【镜头2——4.5-10.0秒——女子特写，过肩反打】
切至女子47°特写，越过右前景年轻男子虚化的深色肩膀拍摄——他的肩随呼吸微微起伏，并在她说话时缓缓转向她几度。她的脸一半火光一半阴影。她说话时全靠眼睛演戏：瞳孔轻微放大，下眼睑因决意而收紧，目光钉在对面的脸上纹丝不动——不是注视，是压迫。说到"现在"一词时她的下巴抬起几毫米，一道近乎狂热的笃定闪过眼中，随即被沉着压回：
女子（冰冷笃定，字字如坠石，句尾带一丝兴奋的颤音，英语）："如果我们现在进军王都，各城会亲自为我们打开城门。"
她的眼睛是自然人眼，烛焰只作为瞳孔下缘一点极小的反射高光存在；双手保持交叠，指节缓缓发白。
【镜头3——10.0-15.5秒——年轻男子反打特写】
同轴侧反打：年轻男子47°特写，越过左前景女子虚化的深色肩膀拍摄，他的侧脸转向她，后脑镶着月光轮廓。前景中女子的肩膀保持稳定，只随呼吸起伏。恐惧最先抵达他的眼睛：两次快速眨眼，目光在她的脸、烛焰与桌面之间逃窜又被拽回，下眼睑泛起一层薄薄的湿光——没有泪落下，只是恐惧的湿润。他摇了一次头仿佛要甩掉这个念头，喉结吞咽滚动，下颌绷紧：
年轻男子（声音紧绷，句中破音一次，后半句近乎哀求，英语）："如果我们错了呢？耶尔纳特会烧了我们的家，连我们一起。"
说到最后一个词时他的呼吸让烛焰轻轻摇摆，桌上的手不自觉地向自己收回半个手掌宽。
【镜头4——15.5-20.0秒——中央男子特写，引线燃烧】
切至中央男子47°正面特写，烛光从下方柔和地暖照他的脸，身后尖拱窗泛蓝。他尚未开口。画外，女子低声催促他表态；另一侧年轻男子的急促呼吸清晰可闻。怒火在他眼中逐级点燃：目光先移向左侧的她——瞳孔收紧；再移向右侧的他——上眼睑沉降为轻蔑的半阖；随后目光落至烛焰并锁定，眼球在极小范围内震颤，像一头被按住的野兽。吸气时鼻翼扩张，咬肌沿下颌鼓起，下眼睑收紧，头缓慢地摇了半下，手指在桌上缓缓收拢成拳，指上的戒指映着烛光。目光冻结，瞳孔中只有蜡烛细小的自然反光。
【镜头5——20.0-25.0秒——爆发，广角】
切回广角主镜头，摄影机静止，坐姿视线高度。中央男子的拳头砸落桌面——沉重的冲击，蜡烛跳起，火焰剧烈甩动几近熄灭，热蜡飞溅，阴影猛烈掠过三张脸。同一动作中他撑桌而起，座椅向后刮擦并翻倒在石地上，他的身躯如黑塔般在恢复中的火焰上方立起，双眼圆睁，眉骨压低：
中央男子（自胸腔引爆的怒吼，随后一声锐利的吸气，英语）："够了！"
女子猛地一颤，一只手本能地按住桌面稳住自己，但目光没有后退——她的眼睛睁得更大迎向他，下巴朝他抬起，仿佛在说"那你继续"；年轻男子整个上身后缩，双肩耸起，一只手抓住桌缘，睁大的眼睛在站立的男子与女子之间快速游移，呼吸可见地加快。
【镜头6——25.0-30.0秒——低角度收束钩子】
切至近侧低机位，略高于桌面，越过恢复中的烛焰仰拍站立的中央男子，火光自下方柔照他的脸，两扇冷蓝尖拱窗分列他剪影两侧。双拳撑桌，他俯身越过火焰逼向另外两人。怒意退回他的眼底，化为更可怕的东西——一种平静的、不再动摇的决意：上眼睑半垂，目光从她缓缓移到他，在每张脸上停留一拍，让每个人都被看进心里。他开口，声音低得几乎贴着桌面爬行，词与词之间悬着令人窒息的停顿：
中央男子（低沉、一字一句、平静得可怕，最后几个字几乎成气声，英语）："初雪之前，阿纳斯王国必将属于我们。否则我们将不复存在。"
画框边缘，女子缓缓直起身，恐惧与得胜同时在她眼中亮起，一个几不可察的点头；年轻男子垂下目光，吞咽一次，再抬起眼——已经变了：恐惧仍在，但一个决定已压在其上。烛焰在他的双拳之间恢复平稳。在他的眼睛上停留两拍。定格结束。
表演
所有表演都具体而肉身化，眼睛是首要乐器：瞳孔的放大与收缩、眼睑高度的变化、眨眼频率的改变、目光的逃窜与钉死、恐惧时下眼睑的湿光、暴怒时眼球的微颤——全部是真实人眼肌肉的表演，绝不夸张、绝不卡通。声音表演同样具体：耳语下的仇恨、破音、哀求、胸腔怒吼、气声——每句台词都有清晰的情绪弧线，绝无平淡念白。听者从不僵住：每句台词都在另外两人身上触发可见的、由台词驱动的肢体与眼神反应。真实的视线连接三人。只有这三个声音，一次只有一人说话，无重叠。
物理
烛焰对每个事件作出反应：随呼吸颤动、在砸拳时剧烈甩动、蜡液飞溅、烟线被撕向一侧、随后恢复稳定。砸拳带有真实质量——桌面震颤，桌上物件作响。椅子带着重量翻倒并在石地上停稳。衣物随每次倾身产生褶皱与位移；起身动作有蓄力、发力与随势，头发与衣领在身体停止后一拍才落定。
灯光
全场锁定：1900K烛光作为所有面孔的主光——温暖、柔和、不对称的下位光；7500K冷月光透过尖拱窗为肩发镶边，让石厅保持深邃通透的蓝色暗部。镜头5中，火焰甩动时，画面整个暖色层随之下沉又恢复，而蓝色月光层保持恒定。每个镜头中面孔都保持可读，眼部有足够光让眼神表演清晰呈现。所有眼睛都是自然人眼：眼中高光只是烛焰的物理反射，细小且不发光；恐惧的湿光只是泪膜的自然反射。眼睛本身不发光、不发亮、没有内部光源。
音频
无音乐。仅音效——全程画内声与现场收音。无配乐、无原声带、无任何背景音乐。英语对白严格按剧本，一次一个声音，情绪演绎符合剧本标注：耳语、破音、怒吼、气声。石砌大厅的环境声：风敲铅条玻璃、烛焰嘶嘶、衣料摩擦、呼吸——随张力升级，呼吸声可闻地愈发清晰。镜头5：拳砸木桌的沉重闷响与桌上物件的轻微震响、椅腿刮擦并翻倒在石地、火焰甩动的呼啸。镜头6：他最后一句台词之下近乎无声——只有蜡烛、风与三个人的呼吸。
风格
写实的现代数字电影，低调古典大师油画色调：琥珀烛光对钢蓝月光，深邃通透的暗部保留石材质感，干净无噪点的画面，宽动态范围，自然皮肤质感，克制精致的调色。
质量
每个特写中面孔与眼睛锐利可读，节奏稳定，仅在拍桌与起身时出现自然的电影运动模糊，无鬼影、无重复肢体、无闪烁。角色身份、服装与场景在所有镜头中与@图1保持100%一致。
正向约束
画面中只有三个人、一支蜡烛与尖拱窗。女子保持画左，年轻男子保持画右，中央男子居中——画面方向与视线轴在每次剪切中保持。光只来自蜡烛与月光。所有眼睛保持自然真实，一切眼神表演均为人眼肌肉运动，无任何发光特效。对白严格为剧本英语台词，无即兴、无字幕、无旁白。

name: 重力错乱之城·信使少女
desc: 少女信使穿越重力随街角翻转的巴洛克石城，镜头随每次跨界同步旋转，梦幻而写实的城市奇观。
original:
An ultra-high-quality surrealist city-spectacle short film: a gravity-scrambled city built on impossible geometry, multi-shot dynamic tracking, a young courier girl crossing a city where gravity keeps flipping — dreamlike yet photorealistic, purely visual with no subtitles, 30 seconds total.
[WORLD RULES — the core of the whole film] The direction of gravity in this city changes at every street corner, every archway, every flight of stairs: pedestrians can walk on walls, ceilings and upside-down bridges, and for each of them, whatever is underfoot is always "the ground." Every resident treats this as completely normal — walking dogs, buying newspapers, drinking coffee — they're simply distributed across different gravity planes. Every time the camera crosses a gravity boundary, the frame rotates and flips with it: what was a wall becomes the new ground.
[ENVIRONMENT] A grand old European stone city — baroque arcades, endlessly extending stone staircases, stacked arch bridges crossing each other at perpendicular angles, clock towers and fountains pointing in different directions, warm morning light pouring in from several "skies" at once, drying bedsheets, fluttering pigeons and falling leaves each drifting along different gravity directions, the space folded and nested like a labyrinth.
[CHARACTER] A young courier girl — short red-brown hair flying, a deep green uniform jacket, a leather mail bag slung across her body, white shirt and short boots, light and athletic in motion, focused and cheerful, a bright yellow letter in her hand.
Shot 1 (3s): The impossible as the everyday — eye-level morning street: the girl sprints along the cobblestones, brushing past an old man walking his dog — while above her, another "street" hangs upside down, pedestrians calmly walking head-down, a woman's red umbrella "hanging" toward the camera's sky. A flock of pigeons flips formation as it crosses between the two gravity fields. Fast lateral tracking. Hard cut.
Shot 2 (3s): The first flip — the girl charges at a wall that looks like a dead end and, without slowing, steps onto it — gravity changes instantly, the camera rotates 90 degrees with her, the wall becoming the new ground: the old street tilts up vertical in the frame, turning into a "cliff" beside her. She keeps sprinting, the hang of her skirt and hair switching direction naturally. A follow-and-rotate move, in one breath. Hard cut.
Shot 3 (3s): The staircase labyrinth — the girl leaps onto a spiral stone staircase coiling around a giant column, its gravity orientation constantly shifting; she runs the steps upright, then side-hanging, then fully inverted, the camera orbiting the column on a spiral path to follow her, the city's gravity planes sweeping past in the background like a kaleidoscope. Fast orbital camera, explosive sense of space. Hard cut.
Shot 4 (3s): The passing moment — where two bridge decks cross: the girl sprints across a bridge while another pedestrian walks the "underside" of the same bridge in the opposite direction; at the instant they cross perpendicular, they meet eyes through the deck, nod and smile to each other, and continue on. The camera catches this mirrored top-and-bottom moment precisely from the side, sunlight flaring on the stone edge between them. One second of slow motion, then back to full speed. Hard cut.
Shot 5 (3s): Falling is flying — the girl leaps off the bridge's edge and "falls" — but mid-fall she crosses a gravity boundary and the plunge instantly becomes an upward soar; she rolls with it and lands cleanly on a plaza overhead, startling a flock of pigeons that scatters in three different directions. The camera follows her fall and flips 180 degrees in sync, weightless vertigo at full strength. Hard cut.
Shot 6 (3s): Through the market — she dashes through a vertical market: vendors hang on the "wall face" selling fruit, and when apples tumble they trace curved arcs along the bent gravity lines; she catches one mid-air and tosses it back to the vendor, who laughs and waves. The camera tracks at high speed, low and hugging the ground (or the wall?), the market's colors and voices rushing past. Hard cut.
Shot 7 (3s): The clock tower sprint — the girl sprints vertically up the clock tower's outer wall (for her, a flat-out dash on level ground); the camera shifts from a top-down view into a "horizontal" tracking move beside her, the huge clock face booming the hour next to her, gears turning, startled pigeons "flying" alongside her. The thrill of speed and bell strikes. Hard cut.
Shot 8 (3s): The delivery — at the top of the clock tower (or rather, the "ground" of another world), an old woman watering flowers upside down in her garden straightens up — the girl vaults the final gravity boundary, lands cleanly in the old woman's garden, and, catching her breath, smiles and holds out the bright yellow letter. The old woman takes it with delighted surprise. Warm sunlight, flower petals drifting down in two directions. Hard cut.
Shot 9 (3s): The city revealed — the camera races up and away from the garden, pulling back and rotating — the full city spectacle unfolds: countless streets, bridges and plazas nested and folded into each other at impossible perpendicular angles, thousands of residents living on their own gravity planes, clotheslines, chimney smoke and pigeon flocks stretching in every direction, the whole city running in the morning light like an intricate, warm three-dimensional puzzle. Grand pull-away, hold the final frame.
Every crossing of a gravity boundary rotates and flips the whole frame with it, flowing with the seamless feel of a single continuous take; warm morning light and the golden texture of stone architecture; pigeons, leaves, bedsheets and petals drifting along multiple gravity directions; alternating shallow depth of field and wide angles; heavy film grain, deep contrast, photorealistic impossible space — wondrous, weightless, breathtaking. Mixed normal speed and slow motion. 21:9.
zh:
一部超高品质的超现实主义城市奇观短片：一座建立在不可能几何之上、重力错乱的城市，多镜头动态跟拍，一位年轻信使少女穿越重力不断翻转的城市——如梦似幻却照片级写实，纯视觉无字幕，全长30秒。
【世界规则——全片核心】这座城市的重力方向在每个街角、每道拱门、每段台阶处都会改变：行人可以走在墙面、天花板与倒挂的桥上，而对每个人而言，脚下之物永远是"地面"。所有居民对此习以为常——遛狗、买报、喝咖啡——他们只是分布在不同的重力平面上。摄影机每次穿越重力边界，画面都随之旋转翻转：原本的墙面成为新的地面。
【环境】一座宏大的欧洲古老石城——巴洛克拱廊、无尽延伸的石阶、以垂直角度相互交叠的层叠拱桥、指向不同方向的钟楼与喷泉、同时从数个"天空"倾泻而入的温暖晨光、晾晒的床单、扑腾的鸽群与落叶各自沿不同重力方向飘移，空间如迷宫般折叠嵌套。
【角色】年轻信使少女——红棕色短发飞扬，深绿制服外套，斜挎皮质邮包，白衬衫与短靴，动作轻盈矫健，专注而开朗，手中握着一封亮黄色的信。
镜头1（3秒）：不可能即日常——视线高度的清晨街道：少女沿鹅卵石路疾跑，擦过一位遛狗老人——而她头顶上方，另一条"街道"倒悬着，行人头朝下从容行走，一位女士的红伞朝镜头的天空"垂挂"。一群鸽子在穿越两个重力场的交界时整队翻转。快速横向跟拍。硬切。
镜头2（3秒）：第一次翻转——少女直冲一面看似死路的墙，不减速地一脚踏上——重力瞬间改变，镜头随她旋转90度，墙面成为新地面：旧街道在画面中竖起，成为她身旁的"悬崖"。她继续疾跑，裙摆与头发的垂坠方向自然切换。跟随+旋转，一气呵成。硬切。
镜头3（3秒）：阶梯迷宫——少女跃上一道盘绕巨柱的螺旋石梯，其重力朝向不断变化；她时而直立、时而侧挂、时而完全倒悬地奔上台阶，镜头沿螺旋路径绕柱跟随，背景中城市的重力平面如万花筒般掠过。快速环绕运镜，空间感爆炸。硬切。
镜头4（3秒）：擦肩瞬间——两层桥面交叉处：少女在桥上疾跑，另一位行人沿同一座桥的"底面"反向行走；在两人垂直交错的瞬间，他们隔着桥面对视、点头微笑，继续前行。镜头精确地从侧面捕捉这上下镜像的一刻，阳光在两人之间的石缘上炸开光斑。一秒慢动作，随后恢复全速。硬切。
镜头5（3秒）：坠落即飞翔——少女跃下桥缘"坠落"——但坠至中途她穿过一道重力边界，俯冲瞬间化为向上的腾飞；她顺势翻滚，干净利落地落在头顶上方的广场上，惊起一群鸽子向三个不同方向散开。镜头跟随她的坠落并同步翻转180度，失重的眩晕感全力释放。硬切。
镜头6（3秒）：穿越市场——她冲过一座垂直市场：摊贩挂在"墙面"上卖水果，苹果滚落时沿弯曲的重力线划出弧线；她凌空接住一只，抛回给摊主，对方大笑挥手。镜头低贴地面（或者说墙面？）高速跟拍，市场的色彩与人声呼啸而过。硬切。
镜头7（3秒）：钟楼冲刺——少女沿钟楼外墙垂直向上疾跑（对她而言是在平地上的全力冲刺）；镜头从俯视转为她身旁的"水平"跟拍，巨大钟面在她身侧轰然报时，齿轮转动，受惊的鸽子与她"并肩飞行"。速度与钟声的震撼。硬切。
镜头8（3秒）：送达——在钟楼顶端（不如说是另一个世界的"地面"），一位倒挂着在花园浇花的老妇人直起身——少女越过最后一道重力边界，干净落进老妇人的花园，喘着气微笑着递出那封亮黄色的信。老妇人惊喜地接过。温暖阳光，花瓣向两个方向飘落。硬切。
镜头9（3秒）：城市全貌——镜头从花园急速拉升远离，一边后拉一边旋转——完整的城市奇观展开：无数街道、桥梁与广场以不可能的垂直角度相互嵌套折叠，成千上万的居民生活在各自的重力平面上，晾衣绳、炊烟与鸽群向四面八方延伸，整座城市在晨光中如一个精密而温暖的三维谜题般运转。宏大拉远，定格最后一帧。
每次穿越重力边界，整个画面都随之旋转翻转，如同一个无缝长镜头般流畅；温暖晨光与石造建筑的金色质感；鸽子、落叶、床单与花瓣沿多个重力方向飘移；浅景深与广角交替；浓重胶片颗粒，深邃对比，照片级写实的不可能空间——奇妙、失重、令人屏息。常速与慢动作混合。21:9。

name: 迟到的爵士钢琴手·雨后疾奔
desc: 雨后金色午后的1950年代街头，迟到首演的爵士女钢琴手一路狂奔：撞上锁死的后台门，穿巷疾跑，最终踏进暖光舞台落座开演。五段四硬切。
original:
SCENE CONTEXT

A young female jazz pianist, late for her matinee debut, sprints through a sunlit 1950s city street just after rain, hits a locked stage door, then cuts through a bright back alley and steps onto a warmly lit stage. One character only, no other featured faces.

ACTIVE REFERENCES

<<<image_1>>>: young woman in her early twenties, 1950s jazz pianist, voluminous chestnut-brown Hollywood waves, red lipstick, emerald green sweetheart cocktail dress with a full knee-length skirt, open beige trench coat, black T-strap heels, pearl stud earrings, gold bracelet, folded ivory sheet-music papers clutched to her chest under her left arm. Face, hair, body, and wardrobe 100% match the reference. Identical in all five segments, no duplicates, no extra featured characters.

FORMAT MODE

Controlled five-segment sequence with four HARD CUTS. Real-time motion, aggressive dynamic pacing. Large-format cinema image: extreme clarity, deep environmental detail, fine film grain. Anamorphic lens character throughout: oval bokeh, subtle horizontal flare streaks from the sun and bright speculars, gentle cylindrical background stretch. Vivid saturated mid-century color palette: rich reds, teals, and yellows, warm golden sunlight, bright open exposure — the whole sequence reads luminous and colorful, never murky, never desaturated.

ACTION TIMING

0.0s to 3.0s — HOOK, wide tracking shot.

84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character, camera 1.2 meters ahead of subject at chest height, tracking backward fast, low, and slightly handheld — urgent momentum, not smooth gimbal glide. A 1950s downtown street in late-afternoon sun right after rain: wet asphalt blazes with golden sun reflections, storefronts in saturated red, teal, and cream, striped awnings, colorful vintage cars along the kerb, a jazz club marquee with round bulbs lit deep in BG, blue sky with white clouds above the rooflines. First visible frame already contains <<<image_1>>> mid-sprint at frame center, x 50%, y 55%, full body visible, running hard toward camera, trench coat cracking behind her, waves bouncing with each stride, heels splashing shallow sunlit puddles. Real sprint physics: heel strikes, opposing right-arm swing, torso lean, sheet music pinned under her left arm.

3.0s HARD CUT.

3.0s to 5.5s — PROBLEM, medium shot.

47° diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 3 meters from subject, handheld with tense micro-movement. Warm red-brick side wall of the club washed in direct golden sunlight, a steel stage door painted deep teal, "STAGE DOOR" stencil in white on the metal, hard sun raking across the brick texture. <<<image_1>>> bursts in from screen-left at full speed, slams into the door, right hand seizing the handle and yanking twice — the door holds with a dull metallic clunk, hinge and lock resisting with real weight. Body faces the door, profile to camera, sunlight modeling her face brightly, sheet music pinned under her left arm. Muffled MC voice and crowd murmur bleed through the wall.

5.5s HARD CUT.

5.5s to 7.5s — PROBLEM, reaction close-up.

18° diagonal field of view, classic telephoto lens character, camera 6 meters from subject, tight close-up on <<<image_1>>>, sunlit brick dissolving into warm golden and teal oval bokeh, one thin horizontal flare crossing the frame. Her face is lit by soft warm bounce off the sunlit wall, skin tones bright and clean, brown eyes alive and catching the sun with soft natural catchlights. First frame opens on her face already in frame: eyes wide, breathing fast, a wave of hair fallen across her cheek. At 6.3s she closes her eyes, one sharp inhale, exhale, eyes snap open with resolve, and her gaze whips toward screen-right. Lips stay closed, no dialogue.

7.5s HARD CUT.

7.5s to 10.0s — SOLUTION SPRINT, alley tracking shot.

84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character, camera tracking alongside <<<image_1>>> at 1.2 meters, screen-right of her body, slight whip energy on the turn. A narrow back alley cut by a bright diagonal shaft of late sun: warm brick walls, laundry lines with colorful fabric overhead catching light, puddles throwing gold reflections up the walls, a plain side door at the alley end glowing in a pool of direct sunlight. First frame: she is already in frame rounding the corner from screen-left at full sprint, coat, skirt, and waves whipping with the turn, sunlit spray kicking behind her heels, her figure flashing through alternating bars of light and open sun. She reaches the sunlit side door at 9.6s and pulls it open — warm interior light meets daylight as the frame cuts.

10.0s HARD CUT.

10.0s to 16.0s — FINAL, stage reveal.

84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character. Interior of the jazz club during a matinee, seen from inside the house — bright and festive, not dark: warm cream-and-gold walls, red velvet curtains glowing under warm tungsten wash, tall side windows spilling soft daylight across the room, the whole stage bathed in warm amber light. A grand piano sits at frame center-right, x 60%, y 55%, its lacquer throwing bright warm speculars, a clean spotlight adding sparkle rather than cutting darkness. Camera starts low near the stage edge and pushes in slowly, rising. Audience heads fill the bottom 15% of frame as softly lit warm bokeh shapes. At 10.8s <<<image_1>>> steps out of the wings from screen-left into the amber light, still catching her breath, composes herself mid-stride, walks to the piano, sets the sheet music on the stand, and sits at 15.0s as the crowd murmur falls silent. Hold the final composition: her emerald dress glowing against red velvet and gold, the frame bright, warm, and celebratory. High-key warm exposure, faces and colors fully readable, no crushed shadows, no gloom.

PHYSICS

Puddles splash with sunlit droplets in exterior segments. The full knee-length skirt swings with her stride, the trench coat and Hollywood waves react with natural delay to sprinting, the corner whip, and the sudden stop into stillness. Heel strikes, the door clunk, and heels on stage boards carry real weight.

LIGHTING

Segments 1 to 4: direct golden late-afternoon sun as primary source, bright blue sky fill, wet surfaces throwing warm speculars, exposure bright and open with clean readable faces — vivid and sunny, never flat grey, never underexposed. Segment 5: warm tungsten stage wash plus soft window daylight, high-key and golden, red velvet and emerald green saturated, gentle sparkle flares off the piano lacquer.

AUDIO

Footsteps, splashes, and lively daytime street ambience in segments 1 to 4; muffled MC and crowd behind the door in segment 2; echoing alley footsteps in segment 4; in segment 5 the room murmur ducks to silence as she sits. No music score, no narration, no spoken lines.

POSITIVE LOCKS

<<<image_1>>> is the single woman in all five segments, identical face, hair, dress, coat, heels, jewelry, and sheet music matching the reference throughout. Screen direction: her resolve gaze in segment 3 aims screen-right, she enters segment 4 from screen-left moving screen-right, and enters the stage in segment 5 from screen-left. Each segment's first frame already contains her as described; no empty establishing frames. The entire sequence stays bright, warm, and color-saturated from first frame to last.
zh:
场景背景

一位年轻的爵士女钢琴手，日场首演迟到，冲刺穿过雨后阳光照耀的1950年代城市街道，撞上一扇锁死的后台门，随即抄近路穿过一条明亮的后巷，踏上暖光照亮的舞台。仅一名角色，无其他主要面孔。

生效参考

<<<image_1>>>：二十出头的年轻女子，1950年代爵士钢琴手，蓬松的栗棕色好莱坞波浪卷发，红色唇膏，祖母绿心形领鸡尾酒裙、及膝伞裙摆，敞开的米色风衣，黑色T字带高跟鞋，珍珠耳钉，金手镯，左臂下抱着折叠的象牙白乐谱纸贴在胸前。脸、发、身形与着装100%匹配参考。五段中完全一致，不复制，不新增主要角色。

格式模式

受控的五段式序列，四次硬切。实时运动，激进的动态节奏。大画幅影院影像：极致清晰度，深邃的环境细节，细腻胶片颗粒。全程变形宽银幕镜头特性：椭圆焦外，太阳与明亮高光带来的微妙水平眩光条纹，轻微的柱面背景拉伸。鲜艳饱和的世纪中期色板：浓郁的红、青、黄，温暖的金色阳光，明亮开放的曝光——整个序列读起来明亮多彩，绝不浑浊，绝不低饱和。

动作时间轴

0.0秒至3.0秒——钩子，广角跟踪镜头。
84度对角线视场角，经典广角镜头特性，摄影机在主体前方1.2米、胸口高度，快速向后跟踪，低位、略带手持——急迫的冲势，而非平滑的稳定器滑行。雨后斜阳下的1950年代市中心街道：湿沥青燃烧着金色的太阳反光，店面是饱和的红、青、奶油色，条纹遮阳篷，路缘停着彩色的老式汽车，背景深处一块圆灯泡亮起的爵士俱乐部招牌，屋顶线之上蓝天白云。第一个可见帧已包含<<<image_1>>>在画面中心冲刺中，x 50%，y 55%，全身可见，朝镜头狂奔，风衣在身后猎猎作响，波浪卷发随每一步弹跳，高跟鞋溅起浅浅的阳光水洼。真实冲刺物理：脚跟落地，右臂反向摆动，軰干前倾，乐谱压在左臂下。

3.0秒硬切。

3.0秒至5.5秒——难题，中景。
47度对角线视场角，标准镜头特性，摄影机距主体3米，手持带紧张的微小晃动。俱乐部温暖的红砖侧墙被直射的金色阳光冲刷，一扇漆成深青色的钢制后台门，金属上白色的“STAGE DOOR”模板字，硬朗的阳光斜掠过砖面肌理。<<<image_1>>>从画左全速冲入，撞上门，右手抓住把手连拽两次——门以一声沉闷的金属哐当纹丝不动，铰链与锁以真实的重量抵抗。身体面向门，侧影对镜头，阳光明亮地塑造她的脸，乐谱压在左臂下。墙内渗出闷响的主持人声与人群低语。

5.5秒硬切。

5.5秒至7.5秒——难题，反应特写。
18度对角线视场角，经典长焦镜头特性，摄影机距主体6米，紧贴<<<image_1>>>的特写，阳光下的砖墙融成温暖的金色与青色椭圆焦外，一道纤细的水平眩光横过画面。她的脸被阳光墙面反弹的柔和暖光照亮，肤色明亮干净，棕色的眼睛鲜活、以柔和自然的眼神光接住太阳。首帧开场她的脸已在画中：双眼睚大，呼吸急促，一缕波浪发垂落脸颊。6.3秒她闭上眼，一次锐利的吸气、呼气，双眼带着决意猛然睪开，目光甩向画右。双唇紧闭，无对白。

7.5秒硬切。

7.5秒至10.0秒——解题冲刺，后巷跟踪镜头。
84度对角线视场角，经典广角镜头特性，摄影机在<<<image_1>>>身侧1.2米处并行跟踪，位于其身体画右一侧，转弯处带轻微甩动能量。一条被明亮的斜射晚阳光柱切开的狭窄后巷：温暖的砖墙，头顶晾衣绳上的彩色织物接住光，水洼把金色反光抛上墙面，巷尾一扇朴素的侧门在直射阳光的光池中发亮。首帧：她已在画中、从画左全速转过街角，风衣、裙摆与卷发随转弯甩动，阳光下的水花在她脚跟后踢起，她的身影在明暗交替的光条与开阔阳光间闪过。9.6秒她抵达阳光下的侧门并拉开——温暖的室内光与日光相接，画面切换。

10.0秒硬切。

10.0秒至16.0秒——终局，舞台揭示。
84度对角线视场角，经典广角镜头特性。日场演出中的爵士俱乐部内部，从观众席一侧看去——明亮而喜庆，绝不昏暗：温暖的奶油金色墙面，红色天鹅绒幕布在温暖钨丝灯洗光下发亮，高大的侧窗把柔和日光洒满房间，整个舞台沐浴在温暖的琥珀光里。一架三角钢琴位于画面中右，x 60%，y 55%，琴漆抛出明亮温暖的高光，一束干净的聚光灯添上闪烁而非切割黑暗。摄影机从舞台边缘附近的低位开始，缓慢推进、上升。观众头顶以柔光温暖的焦外形状填满画面底部15%。10.8秒<<<image_1>>>从画左自侧幕走进琥珀光中，仍在平复呼吸，行进间整理好自己，走向钢琴，把乐谱放上谱架，15.0秒落座，人群低语随之落定为寂静。保持最终构图：她的祖母绿裙衬着红天鹅绒与金色发亮，画面明亮、温暖、庆典般。高调暖曝光，面孔与色彩完全可读，无死黑阴影，无阴郁。

物理
室外段落水洼溅起阳光下的水珠。及膝伞裙随步幅摆动，风衣与好莱坞卷发对冲刺、转角甩动与骤停入静止都有自然延迟的反应。脚跟落地、门的哐当、舞台木板上的鞋跟都带真实重量。

灯光
第1至4段：直射的金色午后晚阳为主光源，明亮的蓝天补光，湿润表面抛出温暖高光，曝光明亮开放、面孔干净可读——鲜艳晴朗，绝不灰平，绝不欠曝。第5段：温暖的钨丝舞台洗光加柔和的窗户日光，高调而金黄，红天鹅绒与祖母绿饱和，钢琴漆面泛起轻柔的闪烁眩光。

音频
第1至4段：脚步、水花与热闹的白天街道环境声；第2段门后闷响的主持人声与人群声；第4段回响的巷中脚步；第5段她落座时室内低语渐弱至寂静。无配乐，无旁白，无台词。

正向锁定
<<<image_1>>>是全部五段中唯一的女子，脸、发、裙、外套、高跟鞋、首饰与乐谱全程与参考完全一致。银幕方向：第3段她的决意目光指向画右，第4段她从画左入画向画右移动，第5段从画左步入舞台。每段首帧已按所述包含她；无空置的定场帧。整个序列从首帧到末帧保持明亮、温暖、色彩饱和。

name: 火把行者·暮蓝密林一镜
desc: 深蓝暮色的密林小径，男子持燃烧火把迎着后退镜头走来，每次挥动都改写脸上光影，冷蓝天光勾出黑色树干，一镜跟拍的火光研究。
original:
SCENE CONTEXT

A lone man walks straight toward the camera through a dark twilight forest, sweeping a burning torch in his right hand as he inspects the dark ahead. Every move of the torch visibly changes the light on his face, while a faint cold blue-hour glow shapes the forest behind him. The shot is a study of one moving flame against dying twilight.

LOCATION MAP

Dense forest at deep blue hour, minutes after sunset. Camera retreats backward along a rough forest path, facing the man. Foreground: the flame, thin drifting smoke, and one blurred fern at the frame edge. Midground: the man walking toward camera over uneven ground of roots and leaf litter. Background: black vertical tree trunks layered into depth, thin ground mist between them, and gaps in the canopy showing a deep twilight-blue sky gradient, darkest overhead, faintly brighter low behind him. The torch is the only warm light; the sky gives only a weak cold ambient.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING

The first visible frame already contains the man walking with the torch burning and the blue twilight visible behind him; no empty establishing frame, no delayed reveal.

The man: mid-thirties, lean and weathered, dark rugged expedition clothing, alert and focused. Frontal, midground at x 50%, y 55%, framed chest-up, torso facing camera, walking straight toward the lens at a slow steady pace, eyes scanning the darkness past the camera.

The torch: gripped in HIS RIGHT hand, which appears screen-left. Flame starts at head height, x 38%, y 40%, about 40 cm from his face. The flame stays inside the frame for the entire shot.

Because the flame starts on his right side, the right side of his face is lit warm and the left side falls into shadow with only a trace of cool blue edge — this left-right logic must stay physically correct all shot.

Foreground occlusion: a dark blurred fern at FG lower-right, x 88%, y 85%, heavily defocused for the full shot.

Background: tree trunks as blue-black silhouettes between x 10% and x 90%, sky gaps glowing dim twilight blue in the upper third.

FORMAT MODE

Single continuous take. Real-time speed. No cuts, no transitions, no speed ramps.

OPTICS

84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character, camera 1.2 to 1.5 meters from the man. Strong but natural perspective, straight lines rectilinear, no fisheye curve. His face is sharp and dominant; the flame blooms soft; the forest recedes into layered blue-black depth. Subtle horizontal flare streak from the flame, gentle optical vignette.

CAMERA

Handheld, eye-level, frontal. The operator walks backward at the man's exact pace, holding the 1.2–1.5 meter distance for all 10 seconds: shoulder-mounted mass, visible breathing sway, soft footstep pulse, small human corrections — organic and alive, never digital jitter, never gimbal-smooth. Focus stays locked on his face for the entire shot; the flame may bloom but never steals focus.

ACTION TIMING

0.0s to 2.5s — Full staging from frame one. He walks toward camera, torch raised beside his right cheek at x 38%, y 40%. The right side of his face glows warm and bright; the left side sits in shadow with a faint cold blue trace; the dividing line runs down his nose. Firelight flickers on his skin in rhythm with the flame.

2.5s to 4.5s — He extends his right arm forward to inspect something ahead: the flame moves toward the camera, growing larger in frame at x 40%, y 45%, and AWAY from his face — the warm light on his face visibly drops and he dims toward a cool blue-edged silhouette against the twilight, while nearby trunks and mist flare warm.

4.5s to 7.0s — He sweeps the torch in an arc across his body to his left side: the flame crosses frame from x 40% to x 62%. As it passes his face the light surges bright for a beat, then the lighting flips — now the LEFT side of his face is lit warm and the right side falls to shadow with its faint blue edge. Long tree shadows rotate through the mist opposite the flame's travel.

7.0s to 8.5s — He pulls the torch back in close, within 25 cm of his left cheek at x 55%, y 38%: light intensity on his skin jumps to its brightest, pores and sweat visible, both eyes catching warm glints, the blue ambient disappearing from his face entirely.

8.5s to 10.0s — Still walking, he lowers the torch to chest height at x 45%, y 58%: the face is now underlit from below, brow and nose shadows invert upward, the top of his head falls to cold blue-black. He keeps moving toward camera, breath fogging warm through the glow.

PHYSICS

Light on the face obeys the flame physically at every moment: closer flame means brighter skin, farther flame means dimmer skin, and the lit side of the face is always the side the flame is on — warm light falls off fast with distance, and where it dies, only the faint blue ambient remains. The flame behaves like real fire: it leans against the arm's motion, stretches on fast sweeps, flutters in night air, recovers when the arm settles; embers detach and drift upward; heat shimmer bends the air above it; thin smoke trails the moving flame. The torch has mass — his wrist and forearm visibly carry and steer it with acceleration and deceleration. His steps land with real weight: leaf litter compresses, twigs snap, roots shift his balance. Ground mist stirs as he passes. Breath vapor drifts in the cold air.

LIGHTING

Two light sources with a strict hierarchy. KEY: the hand-held torch flame — warm orange-amber, flickering, moving; the entire lighting of his face is driven by the flame's position, distance and height, changing continuously and naturally. AMBIENT: faint blue-hour skylight, many times weaker than the torch — a cold blue wash that only separates tree silhouettes from black, breathes a dim gradient into the sky gaps, and leaves the thinnest cool edge on his shoulders, hair and the shadow side of his face; it never fills his features, never competes with the flame. The shot is exposed for the flame: the forest holds deep crushed shadow, no fill light beyond the sky's trace, no flat front light. Halation blooms around the flame; the mist carries warm glow near him and cold blue farther away.

AUDIO

Close torch crackle and flame whoosh on every sweep, footsteps pressing into leaf litter, an occasional twig snap, low night wind moving the canopy, one distant owl call, his controlled breathing. No dialogue, lips still, no subtitles, no score.

POSITIVE LOCKS

The torch is the only warm light for all 10 seconds and the light on his face tracks the flame position at every frame; the blue ambient stays faint and cold. Focus stays locked on his face for all 10 seconds. He walks toward camera and the camera retreats with him for the full duration. Kodak Vision3 500T tungsten texture: dense organic film grain, pronounced halation around the flame, crushed blacks with a soft toe, photochemical palette of deep orange against deep twilight blue. IMAX-scale clarity on his face, Panavision-style anamorphic character: oval bokeh and subtle horizontal flare. Lubezki-style natural-light handheld realism — the frame looks like a real archival film shot, not digital video.
zh:
场景背景

一名独行男子迎着镜头径直穿行于昏暗暮色森林，右手挥动燃烧的火把探查前方黑暗。火把的每次移动都可见地改变他脸上的光，而微弱冷冽的蓝调时刻余光勾勒他身后的森林。本镜头是一场「移动火焰对垂死暮光」的光影研究。

场地地图

日落后数分钟的深蓝调时刻密林。摄影机沿粗糙林间小径面向男子后退。前景：火焰、飘散的细烟与画面边缘一株虚化蕾类。中景：男子踏过树根与落叶铺就的不平地面走向镜头。背景：黑色垂直树干层层叠入纵深，其间薄薄地雾，树冠缝隙露出深暮蓝天空渐变，头顶最暗，他身后低处略亮。火把是唯一暖光；天空只给出微弱冷环境光。

首帧与空间调度

首个可见帧已包含持燃烧火把行走的男子与他身后可见的蓝色暮光；无空场建立帧，无延迟揭示。

男子：三十五岁上下，精瘦风霜，深色硬派探险装束，警觉专注。正面，中景位于x50%、y55%，胸部以上取景，躯干面向镜头，以缓慢稳定的步速径直走向镜头，双眼扫视镜头之外的黑暗。

火把：握在他的右手，出现在画面左侧。火焰起始于头部高度x38%、y40%，距他脸约40厘米。火焰全程保持在画内。

由于火焰起始在他右侧，他脸的右半被暖光照亮，左半落入阴影仅剩一丝冷蓝边缘——这一左右逻辑必须全程物理正确。

前景遮挡：右下前景一株深色虚化蕾类，x88%、y85%，全程重度失焦。

背景：树干作为蓝黑剪影分布于x10%至x90%之间，上三分之一的天空缝隙泛着暗淡暮蓝。

格式模式

单一连续镜头。实时速度。无剪切、无转场、无变速。

光学

84°对角视场，经典广角镜头特性，距男子1.2至1.5米。透视强烈而自然，直线保持直线，无鱼眼弯曲。他的脸锐利而主导；火焰柔和泛光；森林退入层叠的蓝黑纵深。火焰带来细微水平眩光条，柔和光学暗角。

摄影机

手持，视线高度，正面。掌机人以男子完全相同的步速后退，全程10秒保持1.2-1.5米距离：肩扛质量感、可见的呼吸晃动、柔和的脚步脉冲、细小的人为修正——有机而鲜活，绝非数字抖动，也绝非稳定器般平滑。焦点全程锁定他的脸；火焰可以泛光但绝不抢焦。

动作时间轴

0.0-2.5秒——首帧即完整调度。他走向镜头，火把举在右颊旁x38%、y40%。右半脸暖亮发光；左半脸处于阴影，带一丝冷蓝痕迹；明暗分界线沿鼻梁而下。火光随火焰节律在他皮肤上闪动。

2.5-4.5秒——他右臂前伸探查前方：火焰移向镜头，在画面中变大至x40%、y45%，并远离他的脸——他脸上的暖光可见地衰减，他向着一个冷蓝镶边的剪影暗下去，映行暮光，而近处树干与雾气泛起暖光。

4.5-7.0秒——他将火把横越身前扫向左侧：火焰从x40%划至x62%。掠过面孔时光线骤亮一拍，随后光照翻转——现在他左半脸被暖光照亮，右半脸落入阴影带着淡蓝边缘。长长的树影在雾中逆着火焰行进方向旋转。

7.0-8.5秒——他把火把收近至左颊25厘米内，x55%、y38%：皮肤上的光强跳至最亮，毛孔与汗珠可见，双眼映着暖光点，蓝色环境光从他脸上完全消失。

8.5-10.0秒——仍在行进，他把火把降至胸口高度x45%、y58%：面孔转为自下而上的底光，眉与鼻的阴影向上反转，头顶落入冷蓝黑。他继续走向镜头，呼出的白气透着暖光。

物理

面部光照每一刻都物理服从火焰：火焰越近皮肤越亮，越远越暗，被照亮的一侧永远是火焰所在的一侧——暖光随距离快速衰减，光尽处只剩微弱蓝色环境光。火焰表现如真实火焰：逆着手臂运动方向倾斜、快扫时拉长、在夜风中扑动、手臂稳定后恢复；火星脱离上飘；热浪扭曲其上方空气；细烟尾随移动的火焰。火把有质量——他的手腕与前臂可见地承托并带加减速地操控它。脚步落地有真实重量：落叶压实、细枝折断、树根让他的平衡微调。地雾随他经过而搅动。呼气水汽在冷空气中飘散。

灯光
