Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, living eyes with catch-lights, chest rise from breathing. Characters never standing, always reacting.
Physics: Gravity and inertia respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props.
Composition: Rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one.
Continuity: Characters, props, environment identical across every cut. No identity drift.
Technical: 24fps smooth motion. 8K detail. No jitter.
Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.
Characters:
Location reference: @waterfall_location_v1 — the environment (the waterfall, the cave recess behind it, the gorge and canyon) 100% matches the reference across all shots.
Active references attached: @adil_sheet_v2 (the rider) and @dragon_v1 (the dragon) — both stay entirely out of frame for this whole shot. No people, no animals, no creatures visible anywhere — a pure location reveal.
Scene:
High altitude inside a dense grey-white cloud layer hanging over a narrow Icelandic canyon. Below the clouds: a single tall waterfall dropping off the canyon rim past a dark cave mouth, layered basalt walls streaked ochre-yellow and green moss, a pale river threading the canyon floor, flat overcast light. The location must not be visible until the camera breaks through the cloud base.
CUT 1 — Aerial ultra-wide 107° diagonal FOV, rectilinear, forward-diving drone move, lens locked for the whole shot:
First frame: full whiteout inside the cloud — soft volumetric grey-white mist filling the frame edge to edge, faint brightness from above, thin vapor streaks rushing past the lens with the camera's speed. 0–4s: the camera pushes forward and slightly downward through the cloud mass, wisps whipping past, light pulsing brighter and dimmer as density changes. 4–6s: the cloud base tears open — ragged curtains of vapor part around the lens and the landscape resolves below in one continuous reveal. 6–12s: the full establishing vista: the canyon running away from camera, the waterfall at frame center dropping past the dark cave mouth, mossy ochre walls, the pale river far below; the camera keeps a slow cinematic glide forward and down toward the falls, trailing the last shreds of cloud past the frame edges. 12–15s: the glide settles into a calm approach, mist drifting off the waterfall, the vista holding wide and clean. Audio: muffled rushing wind inside the cloud, opening up into wide open-air wind and a distant waterfall roar the moment the camera breaks through. No music.

第二段，

SCENE CONTEXT
ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT — a single take with zero cuts, inside the cave recess @cave_test directly behind a BIG living waterfall — and the falls are present in every frame even though they are never seen: a deep constant roar filling the cave, fine spray drifting in on the air, mist hanging in the bounce light, wet gleam on the gravel. A frontal medium shot on @adil_sheet_v2 — and this shot lives on his face: a young man alone in the dark, genuinely scared, wrestling his own fear out loud before jumping THROUGH that waterfall. He faces the camera — and the cliff edge with the water curtain behind it — backs away two-three unsteady steps deeper into the cave to build his run-up while talking himself into the jump, voice cracking braver than his eyes; a false start he aborts, a shaky laugh at himself, one last deep inhale-exhale — and he explodes into a sprint straight at the lens while the camera pushes forward to meet him, blowing past the frame edge and gone toward the water. True real-time speed, fully grounded and alive. Exactly one person in this shot; no dragon, no other people, no creatures.
ACTIVE REFERENCES
@cave_test: the location — 100% matches the reference. The cave recess behind the waterfall: dark textured basalt walls with horizontal strata, wet gleams and moss streaks, a loose gravel-and-rock floor darkened with damp near the mouth side, the interior receding into deep shadow. The bright cave mouth and the falling water curtain sit BEHIND the camera — never visible in frame, but physically present: their roar, their drifting spray, their cool moving air, and their soft bounce light all live inside the shot. Geography, materials, colors, and atmosphere follow the reference; no new landmarks are invented.
@adil_sheet_v2: Adil — HIGHEST IDENTITY PRIORITY, and there is EXACTLY ONE of him. His face is 100% locked to the reference in every frame: same bone structure, same dark brown eyes, same nose, same black mustache with a light chin patch, same short black curly hair and hairline, same small earrings in both ears, same warm skin tone, same beauty marks, same mid-20s age — the reference is the single source of truth, never regenerated, never averaged into a generic man, and EVERY emotional beat — the raw fear, the trembling breath, the nervous laugh, the set jaw of decision — is performed by this exact face. HIS EYES ARE ALIVE AND HUMAN: they blink naturally and irregularly throughout the take — quick nervous double-blinks, a hard blink after the down-glance, a slow half-second close on the reset — moist, catching light, never a frozen unblinking stare, never a dry mannequin gaze. Build: lean, average height. Wardrobe locked to the reference: a light-grey oversized nylon anorak hoodie with a half-zip, drawstring hood worn down, large front kangaroo flap pocket, and a small black curved wave logo embroidered on the left chest; a white t-shirt showing under the elastic hem; matching baggy light-grey nylon track pants with drawstring cuffs; chunky off-white trail sneakers; a thin silver chain at the neck — essentially dry, only a faint dusting of waterfall mist beading microscopically on the anorak shoulders and glinting in his curls, as anyone standing near big falls would carry. State: honestly frightened — heart hammering, hands unsteady — but forcing himself through it, the voice always half a step braver than the eyes.
LOCATION MAP
The camera stands inside the cave near the cliff edge, at Adil's chest height, aimed INTO the cave depth — its back to the unseen waterfall and daylight. Adil stands facing the camera a few meters in, on the gravel floor. Behind him: the cave runway — an open stretch of dark basalt floor receding into shadow, the far wall barely reading in the gloom. Between camera and Adil, and throughout the cave air: thin drifting waterfall mist, visible as a soft luminous haze in the bounce light, with occasional fine droplets floating through the frame and sparking tiny glints; the haze thins toward the cave depth. Soft bright bounce from the sky and water behind camera falls on his face and chest; the space behind him falls off into darkness. His movement axis is a straight line along the cave's length: first backward away from camera, deeper in — then forward at full sprint toward and past the camera, toward the edge and the falls behind it. The camera works on that same axis: easing backward as he retreats, then driving forward to meet his run. Camera stays on the axis the whole take; the waterfall is never shown.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains Adil mid-emotion — no empty beat, no reveal, no neutral face: a frontal medium close-up, his face and shoulders filling the frame center, x 35% to 65%, and the fear already alive on him — eyes a little too wide aimed past the lens toward the edge, blinking fast, lips slightly parted around shallow breaths, one hand already rubbing its thumb across the fingertips; fine mist drifts through the light between him and the lens, a droplet glinting in his black curls; the pale grey anorak reads bright against the dark wet-gleaming cave wall behind him. Exactly one person in frame for the entire take. As he steps back the framing loosens from medium close-up toward a full medium shot — head to mid-thigh — always frontal, his face always toward camera, every flicker of it readable.
FORMAT MODE
ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS TAKE: zero cuts, zero transitions, zero frame jumps — one camera, one uninterrupted stream of real time at 1x natural speed.
OPTICS
47° diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character — natural human-eye perspective, zero distortion, natural face proportions, comfortable depth of field: Adil razor-sharp down to the catchlights and the mist beads, the cave wall behind him soft but textured. Occasional drifting droplets near the lens read as brief soft specks, never smears, never on-lens water. One lens, locked, no zoom, no focal change.
CAMERA
One camera, genuinely HANDHELD — a documentary-alive operator feel: constant subtle micro-shake, breathing sway, small weight shifts and human corrections, the horizon never dead level for long — organic and nervous like the scene itself, but never whip-panning, never lurching, never nauseating. One continuous three-phase behavior on the cave's long axis. Phase one, retreat with him: as Adil steps backward, the handheld camera walks backward too, mirroring his pace a half-beat behind with real footstep sway, the frame widening from medium close-up to medium. Phase two, settle: when he stops for the final breath, the operator plants — the shake calms to breathing-level micro-movement, sitting with him in the fear. Phase three, drive: the instant he launches, the camera pushes FORWARD toward him with real accelerating handheld energy — shake intensifying with the run — holding his face and torso as he grows huge in two-three strides; he blows past the camera's left edge with strong directional blur, and the camera carries its jolting momentum one more beat into the emptied cave before easing to a stop. No pan-whips, no zoom, no angle change — one axis, in and out.
ACTION TIMING
One continuous chain at true real-time speed — every second carries a living reaction; lips move ONLY for the scripted lines:
0.0s to 2.5s: first frame on his frightened face — fast shallow breathing lifting his shoulders, a quick nervous double-blink, eyes flicking once toward the drop past the lens and jerking back like the look burned; he takes one slow unsteady step backward, then another, sneakers feeling the damp gravel, hands opening and closing at his sides; a nervous wet lick of the lips; mist drifts through the frame; the handheld camera walks back with him.
2.5s to 4.5s: he stops half-step, eyes pinned past the lens, blinks hard once, and speaks quietly, clipped, the first words catching: "Okay… you can do this." — a hard visible swallow, throat bobbing above the white tee collar, and a tiny involuntary head-shake right after the line.
4.5s to 7.0s: one more small step back — the third — his eyes flick DOWN toward the unseen drop and his breath audibly hitches, shoulders flinching; he drags his gaze back up, blinks hard twice, and pushes the next line out: "You just have to jump." — the last word wobbling slightly.
7.0s to 8.5s: a FALSE START — he rocks forward onto his toes as if to go, gets half a lean into it, and bails: rocks back hard, huffs a shaky breath through puffed cheeks, and lets a tiny nervous laugh escape — one breathy "hh", a crooked half-smile flashing and dying — his hand raking back through his mist-damp black curls.
8.5s to 10.0s: he plants himself, jaw working, blinking fast, and says it again — steadier, angrier at his own fear: "Just run — and jump. That's it." — a small sharp nod sealing it.
10.0s to 11.5s: the reset — one long controlled exhale through pursed lips, the breath visibly shaking at its tail and faintly fogging in the cool waterfall air; he shakes both hands loose at the wrists, the loose anorak sleeves flapping once, bounces on his toes, rolls his neck; his eyes close in one slow half-second blink — and open locked past the camera, face still and set: decision beating fear by one point.
11.5s to 13.5s: he EXPLODES forward — first stride driving off the gravel, a raw sharp exhale-grunt tearing out on the launch, second and third strides accelerating hard, body lowering, arms pumping, the baggy nylon snapping around his limbs, teeth bared with effort, growing huge in frame as the handheld camera charges to meet him — and he blows past the camera's left edge in a rush of directional blur, gravel kicking, mist swirling in his wake.
13.5s to 14.5s: the camera's jolting momentum carries one more beat into the now-empty cave — dark runway, mist drifting back into stillness, his last footfalls and one fading breath echoing under the roar — end of the single take.
PHYSICS
Everything obeys real-world body mechanics at real rates, and the fear is fully physiological: shallow uneven chest rise, a hard swallow with visible throat movement, micro-tremor in the fingers and in the exhale, weight shifting foot to foot, ELEVATED NATURAL BLINK RATE — irregular, human, roughly every one-to-two seconds under stress, with the scripted hard blinks and the slow reset blink layered on top — a faint sheen of cold sweat and condensed mist on his temple and upper lip, the nervous lip-lick, the involuntary head-shake — all readable, never cartoonish, never a frozen stare. Loose-clothing physics: the oversized nylon anorak and baggy track pants move with real fabric behavior — rustling and shifting with every step, the kangaroo pocket flap bouncing lightly, the hood drawstrings swinging, the elastic hem riding over the white tee; in the sprint the slipstream plasters the loose fabric back against his chest and thighs while the sleeves and pant legs snap and ripple. The waterfall's presence is physical: cool air moves gently through the cave, drifting the mist in slow visible currents; fine droplets float, settle, and glint; his exhale fogs faintly; the gravel near the mouth side is dark with damp and grips differently underfoot — his launch strides bite it with a wet crunch. The backward steps are careful: heel feeling for the gravel, weight transferring fully, small arm corrections. The false start is honest biomechanics: weight loads forward, torso tips — the abort throws it back through the heels, arms flaring. The nervous laugh jolts his shoulders once; the hair-rake flicks a fine spray of mist off his curls. The sprint launch is earned: back-foot load, torso past base, short explosive first stride, lengthening acceleration, arms opposite legs, gravel scattering, one stone skittering. The pass-by is a real near-miss with a felt whoosh. Dust and mist hang and resettle after him. No floating, no rubbery limbs, no teleporting; the cave stays completely static.
LIGHTING
Natural motivated light only: soft bright bounce from the unseen sky and waterfall behind the camera keys Adil's face and chest — even, wrapping, gentle — while the cave falls into deep shadow behind him. The pale grey anorak catches the bounce and separates him cleanly against the dark basalt, the small black wave logo reading crisply on his left chest, the white tee glowing softly at the hem and collar. The drifting waterfall mist makes the light VISIBLE: a soft luminous haze between camera and subject, faint volumetric depth in the bounce, tiny droplet glints crossing the frame; wet basalt and damp gravel carry low specular gleams. Both eyes hold clear moving catchlights that flicker naturally with every blink; the too-wide eyes, the swallow, the down-flick, the dying half-smile, the sweat-and-mist sheen, the final set jaw — all fully lit and readable, no shadow ever crushing his features. As he retreats deeper the key softens one step and the haze thins; the sprint carries him back into the brighter, mistier zone, light rising on his face over the final strides. No sun disc, no rays, no lens flare, no artificial light. Exposure protects his face; the cave shadow keeps faint texture, never flat dead black.
AUDIO
One continuous soundscape, no breaks, and the WATERFALL OWNS THE ROOM: a deep, powerful, ever-present roar from behind the camera — low rumbling bass with a hissing spray top layer, swelling and easing in slow natural waves, echoing off the cave walls — loud enough that Adil speaks slightly over it; occasional fat droplets smack the gravel; the cool air moves audibly. Inside that: Adil's uneven breathing close and intimate, hitching at the down-glance; the soft nylon rustle of the anorak with every movement; damp gravel crunching under each backward step; his three quiet lines — "Okay… you can do this." … "You just have to jump." … "Just run — and jump. That's it." — spoken by Adil only, in English, exactly these words and nothing more, pushed slightly against the roar, the first delivery tight and thin, the last one firmer; between the second and third lines the huffed shaky breath and one tiny breathy laugh — non-word; the long trembling exhale of the reset; the soft slap of shaken hands; the raw sharp effort-grunt on the launch — non-word, Adil only; then explosive pounding footfalls rushing toward and past the lens with a whoosh, swallowed by the rising roar as he heads for the water. No other voices, no ad-libs, no music, no subtitles.
STYLE
Grounded photoreal cinema — intimate, tense, human; a fear-and-courage character beat against the physical presence of a giant waterfall. No 3D-render look, no game-engine smoothness, no slow motion. Natural 180-degree shutter motion blur at real-time speed: the dialogue and reaction beats hold razor-sharp through the handheld sway, the false start reads clean, the sprint and pass-by carry strong honest directional blur. Pore-level skin realism in the soft misty light — vellus hair, the adrenaline flush rising through the take, the cold-sweat-and-spray sheen, living blinking eyes with dancing catchlights. Real organic film grain, deep filmic contrast with lifted shadow detail. Muted grade: dominant dark basalt grays and umber, secondary soft daylight and mist on skin, the pale grey anorak and white tee as the light accents.
POSITIVE LOCKS
One single unbroken take: zero cuts, zero transitions, zero frame jumps, one handheld camera from first frame to last. Exactly one person in the entire shot — a single Adil, never duplicated; no dragon, no silhouettes, no figures in the shadows. Adil's identity locks to @adil_sheet_v2 with absolute priority in every frame — same face, dark brown eyes, black mustache with light chin patch, black curly hair, earrings, skin tone — and the same outfit: light-grey half-zip anorak hoodie with the black wave logo on the left chest, white tee underneath, baggy grey nylon track pants, off-white trail sneakers, thin silver chain — zero drift, zero substitution, no wardrobe changes, through every expression change; his face stays toward camera until the sprint carries him past it; the hood stays down the whole take. HIS EYES BLINK NATURALLY AND IRREGULARLY THE ENTIRE TAKE — nervous quick blinks, hard blinks, one slow reset blink — never more than two seconds without a blink, never a frozen stare. The waterfall's presence persists the whole take: constant roar, drifting visible mist, damp gravel, cool moving air — but the falls themselves are NEVER visible; they exist only as light, spray, and sound behind the camera. His clothes stay essentially dry with only faint mist beading — never soaked. The emotional arc locks in this exact order, each beat once: frightened breathing and fidgeting → line one with swallow and head-shake → third step back, down-glance with breath hitch → line two with a wobble → ONE false start aborted → ONE nervous breathy laugh with hair-rake → line three, firmer, with a nod → trembling fogged exhale reset with slow blink → explosive sprint with ONE effort-grunt → exit past the lens. Dialogue is ONLY the three scripted English lines in that order — no extra words, no ad-libs, no off-screen voices; the laugh and grunt are wordless. His fear is human-scale — trembling, hesitating, self-mocking — never sobbing, never screaming, never frozen panic. The camera moves only on the cave's long axis with organic handheld life: back with his retreat, planted for the breath, forward to meet his run — no pan-whips, no angle change, no zoom. Adil fully exits past the camera's left edge before the end, leaving at least one beat of empty misty cave. The whole shot plays at 1x real-time speed — no slow motion anywhere. 47° lens locked. Sharp clarity through natural handheld motion, stable exposure, no flickering, no ghosting.

Scene:

Inside the cave recess behind the waterfall, facing out. Between the cliff lip and the falling water there is a wide corridor of open air — the waterfall hangs well away from the cave. The torrent itself is an immense, extremely dense mass of white falling water, flood-volume, so thick that nothing can be seen through it, throwing heavy spray. @adil_sheet_v2 is in the final stride of his sprint toward the edge; the camera chases behind him.

Hard endpoint: THE MOMENT HE LEAPS INTO THE VOID, THE CAMERA STOPS DEAD AT THE CLIFF LIP — no tilt down after him, no drift, no push in; from that instant it is a static locked frame to the last second. Tension hangs in the emptiness. 3–5s: the dragon EXPLODES up into the frame from below the cliff edge — rising inside the air corridor, clearly in front of the torrent, closer to the lip than to the water: one violent vertical burst, sudden like a breaching whale, back and tail to camera, heavy directional motion blur, two brutal wing strokes, grit blasting over the lip — the rider pressed flat between the wing roots, jolting with the burst. 5–6s: at the top of the burst, in the same motion, it snaps over — head pitches forward, tail whips up — vertical momentum converting straight into forward drive, no hover. 6–15s: it charges FORWARD away from the camera and punches horizontally through the torrent: true fluid physics — tons of water shatter at the impact point, the dragon vanishing inside the mass for a split second, then bursting out the far side hauling sheets, ropes and spray on real ballistic arcs; water cascades off the wings; the torrent slams shut behind it as if never broken; fine droplets spatter the lens. Audio: footsteps and hard breathing, the raw scream fading into the roar, one second of waterfall thunder alone, then an eruption of wing-thunder from the gorge, the concussive detonation of the breached torrent, hissing away with distance. No music.
One unbroken take: camera moves only during the chase, stops dead at the leap, stays static to the last frame. He and the dragon are out of view only during the one-second stillness. Exactly one man and one dragon in the whole shot.

LOCATION MAP
The camera sits OFFSET TO THE SIDE of the falls, not in front of them: its optical axis runs parallel to the cliff face, so the waterfall reads edge-on as a narrow translucent ribbon at screen-left — the front face of the falls is never visible and the falls are never frame-centered. The flight line runs out of the cave perpendicular to the veil, then bends level and parallel to the cliff, screen-left to screen-right; the camera travels on a rail-straight lateral path on the canyon side of that line, holding the dragon in full side profile at constant height — the same side-on angle from first frame to last, never crossing the line, never rotating toward the falls.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING

一切遵循真实世界的身体力学与真实速率，恐惧完全生理化：浅而不均的胸口起伏，一次喉部动作可见的重咽，手指与吐气中的微颤，重心在双脚间来回移动，眨眼频率自然升高——不规则、有人味，在压力下约每一到两秒一次，其上再叠加台词处的重眨与重置时的缓慢一眨——太阳穴与上唇一层淡淡的冷汗与凝雾光泽，紧张的舔唇，不由自主的摇头——全部清晰可读，绝不卡通化，绝不凝固直瞪。宽松衣物物理：oversize尼龙冲锋衣与宽松运动裤以真实织物行为运动——随每一步沙沙作响、挪动，袋鼠兜盖轻轻弹跳，兜帽抽绳摆动，松紧下摆蹭过白T恤；冲刺中气流把宽松织物压贴回他的胸口与大腿，袖子与裤腿啡啡抖动、起伏。瀑布的存在是物理性的：清凉空气缓缓穿过洞窟，把水雾推成缓慢可见的流动；细小水珠漂浮、落定、闪光；他的吐气微微起雾；洞口一侧的砾石被潮气浸暗、脚感抓地不同——他起跑的步伐带着湿脆声咬进砾石。后退的脚步很小心：脚跟试探砾石，重心完全转移，手臂小幅修正。假起跑是诚实的生物力学：重心前压，躯干前倾——中止把它甩回脚跟，双臂张开。紧张的失笑让他肩膀一震；扳发把一蓬细雾从卷发上甩出。冲刺起跑是挣来的：后脚蓄力，躯干越过支点，短促爆发的第一步，逐渐拉长的加速，手脚交替，砾石四散，一颗石子打着旋滑走。擦身而过是真实的近距离掠过，带一声可感的呼啸。尘与雾在他身后悬起又落定。无漂浮，无橡胶肢体，无瞬移；洞窟完全静止。

骑手的双手在每一帧都紧握颈棘——绝不松开，绝不抬起，绝不挥舞。一切都活在身体的倾侧与脸上：过弯时压平贴紧，穿云时头缩在棘刺之后，而在迎面收尾段全由脸来承载——咧笑裂成呐喊，脸颊在气流中颤抖，潮湿的头发狂甩，日光刃掠过时眼神光骤亮。

物理
三十吨的躯体以130公里时速飞行：侧倾过弯时翼骨可见弯曲，飞沫与尾迹服从振翅节奏，穿云时水汽围绕躯体诚实地撕裂，每个弯都有真实惯性；在摄影机划弧期间，巨龙自身的飞行保持笔直水平——所有弧线运动都属于摄影机。玻璃上的水珠服从气流——以分离的珠粒落上，随震颤发抖，向画框边缘拉出水痕；穿云带来的湿膜在一秒内撕走。骑手80公斤的体重在每次滚转前一瞬先行倾侧。窄于翼展的缝隙只以刀刃式侧倾或半收翼通过，翼尖以臂长之距擦过岩石。

灯光
厚重破碎云层的日光：主导的是柔和发亮的6000K云光、带爬行的阴影斑块，一道坚硬的5600K日光刃扫过一道撕裂的云隙——恰在摄影机弧线的侧点处横越飞行线，逆光点燃琥珀色翼膜、引燃镜片水珠的火花；湿皮革与搅碎的水面拾起柔和高光，冷雾沿峡谷深处渐浓，云絮在被击穿时自内发光。

音频
只有风与水：擂击般的振翅伴飞沫囖鸣，尾迹的撕裂奔涌，湿飞沫嗒嗒溅打摄影机护壳，岩扶壁掠过镜头时的一声多普勒呼啸，云絮内部一团闷压的白噪轰鸣，迎面逼近时渐涨的雷鸣与抖振隆隆，以及骑手被风撕碎的呐喊。无配乐，无字幕。

风格
照片写实的实拍航拍追逐摄影，8K级细节带细腻颗粒，真实的爬行类解剖结构，真实的水、水汽与织物行为，明快的冰岛调色——冷调阴影，罕见的暖阳点缀。

输出设置
从头到尾实时，一条不间断长镜头，21:9。

正向锁定
恰好一条龙与一名骑手；骑手在每一帧都以@size_ref_v2的比例跨坐在颈根处，双手从首帧到末帧紧握颈棘，在弧线的每个视角下都是一个连续、解剖完整的剪影——从背后、从侧面、迎面时身份与着装完全一致。抖动始终是细微恒定的震颤，镜片水珠折射而不遮挡动作——巨龙与骑手的脸在每一帧都清晰可读。翼、岩石与摄影机绝不相交或相触；180度弧线发生在开阔河段上空、远离一切岩石。潮湿状态与着装从首帧到末帧完全一致。

第六段

风格：8K IMAX。照片级写实——无3D渲染，无游戏引擎。
灯光：仅自然光——逆光背光，摄影机位于阴影侧，全程大气雾霭。主光仅来自天空。无人工照明。
色彩：60:30:10——主导/次要/点缀。
摄影机：物理电影镜头。180度快门运动模糊。
皮肤：毛孔级写实——毫毛、不对称的痣、毛细血管潮红、毛孔阴影匹配现场光。
表演：好莱坞级——反应前的微停顿，精确的视线，带眼神光的鲜活双眼，呼吸带动的胸口起伏。角色从不呆立，永远在反应。
物理：尊重重力与惯性——质量有真实重量，正确的接触阴影。无漂浮道具。
构图：三分法+黄金比例。
连贯性：角色、道具、环境在每个剪切间完全一致。无身份漂移。
技术：24fps流畅运动。8K细节。无抖动。
音频：仅环境音效。无配乐。无字幕。
角色：
@dragon_v1——巨龙，100%匹配@dragon_v1参考（解剖结构、皮革质感、翼膜、棘刺列）：炭黑色巨龙，蝠蝠式半透明琥珀棕膜翼，带刺长尾。
@adil_sheet_v2——骑手，身份与着装100%匹配@adil_sheet_v2参考：二十五六岁男子，深色短卷发，黑色细髠；oversize浅灰尼龙连帽冲锋衣带小黑胸徽、内搭白T恤，宽松浅灰尼龙长裤，米白厚底运动鞋，织物仍带瀑布余湿。
@size_ref_v2——仅控制骑手与龙的尺寸比例及骑坐方式：骑手跨坐在龙颈与肩相接的颈根处、双翼根之间，双腿垂沿龙的两胁，双手扶在身前的颈脊上——比例与坐位完全如@size_ref_v2；他的上身可随飞行倾侧（高速与俯冲时压低，平稳滑翔时坐直），但坐位与尺寸比例永不改变。参考自身的背景、光线、摄影机与骑手的脸不被继承。恰好一条龙与一名骑手。
场景：
一片无尽云层的内部与阳光照耀的顶面。镜头始于云的深处：四面八方都是寒冷、稠密、亮灰色的水汽，完全空无一物——没有身影，没有影子，除雾之外别无他物。云层之上：金白色的云顶在深邃蓝白的天空下伸展至地平线，一轮低垂的金色太阳正在飞行线的正前方。云下的世界永不可见。摄影机独自攀升、穿过空无的云层内部，破出云顶之上——直到此刻巨龙与骑手才变得可见，已在日光线上飞在前方，自己也是刚刚破云而出；摄影机落定在其身后展开追随。
镜头1——连续的单独攀升-破云、接入自后方的低位向前追随，84度对角线视场角，摄影机稳定攀升穿过空无的云层内部，击穿云顶之上，倾平对准日光线，找到前方的巨龙并落定为平稳的尾随追拍，结尾缓缓收力，镜头锁定：
首帧：云层深处的全白画面——寒冷、稠密、亮灰的水汽充满画面每个角落，发亮却无方向，粗厚的雾缕随摄影机的攀升滑过；雾中不存在任何其他事物。0–2秒：空无的攀升——摄影机独自升过翻搅的冷灰稠雾，昏浊密实而无特征，随云顶临近，头顶亮度缓缓积聚，更浅的光开始以纤细的光缕刺下、穿过渐薄的水汽；无剪影，无影子，只有雾与风。2–3秒：破云——摄影机击穿云层进入开阔空气并倾平：金色云海向地平线铺展，日盘低垂、正在正前——他们就在那里，同一瞬间被揭示：@dragon_v1在日光线上领先两个身长，尾部正对镜头，双翼沉重地划动，@adil_sheet_v2低伏在颈根处，水汽的丝带仍从双翼、尾与两胁倾泻，其下方薄幕中一个缓缓闭合的旋涡——两者都刚从同一片云层破出。
3–5秒：摄影机落定为尾随追拍，这对龙与骑手在呼吸般起伏的云顶正上方拉平飞行，巨龙的下洗气流在尾迹中滚起层层雾浪，最后的水汽从棘刺上脱落；骑手在坐位上坐直一拍，饱览金色云海。5–6.5秒：巨龙俯首向下，双翼半收，刀锋般切回前方云层——雾以一个柔软上涌的旋涡吞没它、在龙尾后卷拢闭合，没有水花，骑手压低身体进入俯冲；有一拍时间，只剩它黑暗的躯体作为薄幕之下的影子疾驰，犁出一道被搅亮的发光雾垄，拖尾并缓缓抚平——摄影机在云顶之上保持自己的航线。6.5–9秒：影子猛然提速，巨龙以一次悠长的海豚式跃潜冲出——一道更高更慢的弧线，双翼啡然张开、甩脱在半空蒸散的雾带，骑手平贴龙颈，日光在弧顶闪过琥珀翼膜——随后它收翼、第二次刀锋般切回云下，云层以又一个柔软旋涡将其吞没，疾驰的影子与雾垄继续冲向太阳。9–11秒：最终喷发——巨龙以一道陡峭的上升弧线彻底爬出，水汽以柔软消散的水片从翼膜与带刺长尾上倾泻，随即在云顶正上方拉平飞行，下洗气流在尾迹中滚起雾浪，摄影机保持足够低的追随，让零散的雾丝掠过镜头边缘。11–13.5秒：剪影滑上低垂的日盘——画面沉入深琥珀色，翼膜燃成半透明的火，柔和的镜头眩光包裹黑色剪影，近乎日食的画面在两次缓慢振翅间保持。13.5–15秒：巨龙滑离日盘远缘，曝光落定，龙与骑手融入云海之上的金色辉光，摄影机缓缓收力，最后的雾丝飘过镜头。
音频：开场是一个寒冷闷压的茧——只有稀薄的内部囖鸣与风，无振翅声，雾中没有任何活物——风声随攀升渐涨渐亮，破云一瞬爆入开阔的高空之风，同时立刻加入前方巨龙沉重的振翅，云顶之上平静有力的划动，俯冲与影子疾驰段一声深沉呼啸与一路疾行的闷囖，跃潜与最终喷发处一声巨大的撕碎水汽的呼啸，低飞段渐涨的空速轰鸣，随后声音在保持的日食画面中稀薄至近乎无声，收在开阔的风声上。无配乐。自然的180度快门运动节奏：昏浊雾中、撕碎的雾、俯冲与跃潜里是真实运动模糊，揭示一瞬、每个弧顶与衬着日盘时是锐利可读的剪影。
正向约束：一次连续不间断的镜头运动，无剪切；云内画面只含寒冷、稠密、亮灰的水汽——破云之前无龙、无骑手、无剪影、无影子、无振翅声；云层内部的水汽是寒冷发亮的灰，绝不昏暗，光只会向顶部渐亮渐暖、绝不回冷；巨龙与骑手在摄影机破出云层的那一瞬首次可见——已在其前方，尾部正对，刚刚破出，拖着水汽；摄影机恰好破出一次、绝不再入云层；云全程表现为无重量的水汽——它分开、旋转、被撕碎并缓缓回填，绝不像水、果冻或织物那样起涟漪、溅水花或撕裂；揭示之后巨龙恰好两次潜入云层之下、又恰好两次再度跃出，以干净的海豚式弧线、始终在摄影机前方；摄影机绝不超越它；巨龙恰好一次横越日盘，在结尾处；整个镜头中恰好出现一条龙与一名骑手。

name: 崖顶篝火·五友之约
desc: 蓝调黄昏的滨海草崖上，五位好友围火立约每月一聚，五段四硬切的15秒写实对话戏。
original: SCENE CONTEXT: Five friends around a small campfire on a grassy coastal bluff, late blue-hour dusk. They agree to meet more often. Real-time, about 15s, five segments, four hard cuts. CAST, five distinct people, no repeated face or wardrobe: P1 man 32, dark-blond, light grey henley. P2 man 29, dark curls, stubble, dark green shirt-jacket. P3 woman 27, long straight black hair, olive field jacket. P4 woman 30, wavy copper hair, cream cable knit. P5 woman 26, ash-blonde low bun, navy cardigan. Exactly five people. No twins, no duplicated wardrobe, no extra figures. BLOCKING: Fire foreground center, x50 y74, blurred. Group in a semicircle beyond it, 1.5 m from flames. Camera stays on one side of the fire; the 180 axis runs through the fire and is never crossed. P3 and P4 stay screen-left looking camera-right; P1, P2, P5 stay screen-right looking camera-left. First frame already shows three people seated in position, no empty establishing frame. OPTICS AND CAMERA: Seg 1 and 5, 47 degree FOV, camera 3.5 m, group two/three-shot. Seg 2 and 4, 29 degree FOV, camera 4.5 m, close-up with a blurred listener's shoulder in the near foreground. Seg 3, 47 degree FOV, camera 3 m, medium close-up. No lens drift inside a segment. Shoulder-held at seated eye level, slow operator breath, shutter 270-360 degrees, natural motion blur. No zoom, no push-in, no digital jitter. BEATS: 1. Group wide. P1 to P3: "I don't know why we let a whole year go by." Hard cut. 2. P3 close-up, eyes on P1 off-frame right: "Then let's stop letting it." Hard cut. 3. P4 medium close-up, mug in hands: "Same fire, same people. Once a month." Hard cut. 4. P5 close-up, three-quarter left, sparks crossing frame: "I'm holding all of you to that." Hard cut. 5. Back to P1 with P2 behind: "Then it's a plan." Long held static final beat. Only the named speaker talks; listeners keep lips closed. No offscreen voices. PHYSICS: Fire burns like real wood, fast irregular tongues, tips breaking off, uneven height, thin smoke drifting one way. Sparks rise on turbulent curved paths and fade, never in straight lines. Light sea wind moves loose hair and smoke consistently. Bodies carry weight, mugs tilt with liquid inertia. LIGHTING: Key is the fire itself, 2200-2700K, from below. Fill and rim from cold 6500K dusk sky, separating each person from the dark ridge. Firelight swells slowly and organically with the flame shape, shadows rolling off gradually. No high-frequency strobing, no stepped luminance jumps, no unmotivated source. Warm catchlight in every eye. AUDIO: Only the five scripted English lines, close and dry. Continuous wood crackle, quieter on close-ups, soft wind and distant surf. Ambient ducks under speech. No music, no subtitles. LOOK: Photoreal, shot on ARRI Alexa 35, natural grain, warm fire against cold blue dusk, visible pores, freckles, fabric weave. Same faces, wardrobe, seating order, fire size and light direction across every cut. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
zh:
场景背景：五位好友围坐在滨海草崖上的小篝火旁，深蓝调黄昏。他们约定以后要更常见面。实时，约15秒，五段，四次硬切。

演员，五个截然不同的人，无重复面孔或服装：P1男，32岁，深金发，浅灰亨利衫。P2男，29岁，深色卷发，胡茬，墨绿衬衫式夹克。P3女，27岁，黑长直发，橄榄色工装夹克。P4女，30岁，铜色波浪发，奶油色绞花针织衫。P5女，26岁，灰金色低发髛，藏青开衫。恰好五人。无双胞胎，无重复服装，无多余人影。

走位：篝火前景居中，x50 y74，虚化。人群在火焰之外1.5米处围成半圆。摄影机始终停在火的一侧；180度轴线穿过篝火且绝不越轴。P3与P4保持画左、看向画右；P1、P2、P5保持画右、看向画左。首帧即已有三人落坐就位，无空镜建立帧。

光学与摄影机：第1、5段，47度视场角，机位3.5米，群像双人/三人镜头。第2、4段，29度视场角，机位4.5米，特写，近前景带一个虚化的聆听者肩膀。第3段，47度视场角，机位3米，中近景。段内无镜头漂移。肩扛于坐姿视线高度，缓慢的掌机呼吸感，快门270-360度，自然运动模糊。无变焦，无推近，无数字抖动。

节拍：1. 群像全景。P1对P3：“I don't know why we let a whole year go by.”（真不知道我们怎么就让一整年溜过去了。）硬切。2. P3特写，目光投向画右框外的P1：“Then let's stop letting it.”（那就别再让它溜走了。）硬切。3. P4中近景，双手捧杯：“Same fire, same people. Once a month.”（同一堆火，同一群人。每月一次。）硬切。4. P5特写，四分之三朝左，火星掠过画面：“I'm holding all of you to that.”（你们每个人我都盯着兑现。）硬切。5. 回到P1，P2在其身后：“Then it's a plan.”（那就说定了。）长时间静止保持的最终节拍。只有点名的说话者开口；聆听者双唇闭合。无画外人声。

物理：火像真实木柴那样燃烧，快速不规则的火舌，火尖断裂脱落，高度参差不齐，细烟朝同一方向飘散。火星沿湍流曲线路径上升并渐次熄灭，绝不走直线。轻柔海风让散发与烟保持一致方向的飘动。身体有重量感，杯子随液体惯性倾斜。

灯光：主光是篝火本身，2200-2700K，自下而上。补光与轮廓光来自冷调6500K黄昏天空，把每个人从暗色山脊中分离出来。火光随火焰形状缓慢有机地起伏，阴影渐次滚落。无高频频闪，无阶梯式亮度跳变，无无动机光源。每个人眼中都有温暖的眼神光。

音频：只有五句照本英文台词，近距且干净。持续的木柴劈啊声，特写时更轻，柔和的风与远处海浪。环境声在台词下自动压低。无音乐，无字幕。

质感：照片级真实，ARRI Alexa 35拍摄，自然颗粒，暖火光衬冷蓝黄昏，毛孔、雀斑、织物织纹清晰可见。每次剪切前后面孔、服装、座次、火势与光向保持一致。无文字，无标志，无水印。

name: 复古客厅·慢舞升降一镜
desc: 1950年代午后客厅，年轻夫妇随哼唱华尔兹慢舞，额头特写匀速拉远至中全景的8秒复古一镜。
original: SCENE: A young couple slow dances in the living room of a 1950s home, late afternoon. One continuous take, about 8 seconds, real-time. SUBJECTS: Man 30, dark combed-back hair, white shirt with suspenders and dark trousers. Woman 27, soft waves, floral tea dress, low heels. Both faces stay identical from the extreme close-up to the wide shot. CAMERA: Single continuous crane back at a constant eye level, 1.5 m above the floor. Opens on an extreme close-up of their touching foreheads, glides steadily backward and slightly up into a medium wide shot, holding the couple centered in the middle third with clear headroom. 40 degree field of view, shutter 270-360 degrees, no zoom, no low-angle tilt, no speed change. ACTION: They rotate slowly and continuously through a full quarter turn as the camera retreats. Each step lands with a real heel-to-toe contact and weight transfer, soles gripping the rug, no sliding, no floating. She laughs softly midway and lets her head tilt against his shoulder. HANDS AND CONTACT: His right hand rests flat and open on her upper back, fingers distinct. Her left hand sits on his shoulder with five separate visible fingers. Their other two hands are clasped at chest height, two anatomically separate hands with individual fingers, knuckles and skin folds readable throughout the turn. Hands never fuse, never sink into fabric. SET: Period living room, sofa, patterned rug, table lamp, framed picture, wooden radio cabinet, three curtained windows behind the couple. All furniture and props keep rigid, stable geometry while the camera moves; nothing warps or shifts scale with parallax. LIGHTING: Warm 4000K afternoon sun as backlight through sheer curtains, constant intensity, soft rim on hair and shoulders. Gentle even fill from camera-left. Volumetric beams and dust motes stay steady with slow natural drift. No lens flare, no pulsing rays, no flicker. AUDIO: He hums a slow waltz melody under his breath, she laughs quietly once. Faint fabric rustle and shoe contact on the rug. Room tone only, no music track. LOOK: Photoreal vintage cinema, warm muted pastel grade, soft contrast, fine grain, readable skin pores and fabric weave. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
zh:
场景：一对年轻夫妇1950年代住宅的客厅里慢舞，午后将晚。单一连续镜头，约8秒，实时。

主体：男，30岁，深色背头，白衬衫配背带与深色长裤。女，27岁，柔软波浪发，碎花茶歇裙，低跟鞋。从大特写到中全景，两人面孔保持完全一致。

摄影机：单一连续升降臂后拉，恒定视线高度，离地1.5米。开场是两人相触额头的大特写，平稳向后滑动并微微上升至中全景，把两人稳定居中在画面中间三分之一、留出清晰头顶空间。40度视场角，快门270-360度，无变焦，无低角度仰拍，无速度变化。

动作：随镜头后退，两人缓慢连续地旋转整整四分之一圈。每一步都有真实的脚跟到脚尖落地与重心转移，鞋底抓住地毯，无滑动，无漂浮。中途她轻声一笑，任头靠上他的肩。

手与接触：他的右手平摊张开贴在她的上背，手指分明。她的左手搭在他肩上，五根手指清晰可见、彼此分开。另外两只手在胸口高度相握，是两只解剖学上彼此独立的手，整个旋转过程中指节与皮肤褶皱清晰可读。手绝不融合，绝不陷进布料。

布景：年代客厅，沙发，花纹地毯，台灯，相框，木质收音机柜，夫妇身后三扇挂帘窗。摄影机移动时所有家具与道具保持刚性稳定的几何形态；无任何物体随视差扭曲或改变比例。

灯光：温晦0的4000K午后阳光透过薄纱窗帘作逆光，强度恒定，在发丝与肩上形成柔和轮廓光。画左有轻柔均匀的补光。体积光束与尘埃微粒保持稳定，只缓慢自然漂移。无镜头眩光，无脉动光线，无闪烁。

音频：他低声哼着缓慢的华尔兹旋律，她轻轻笑了一声。微弱的布料摩擦与鞋子接触地毯声。仅房间底噪，无音乐轨。

质感：照片级真实的复古电影感，温暖柔和的粉彩调色，柔对比，细腻颗粒，皮肤毛孔与织物织纹清晰可读。无文字，无标志，无水印。

name: 雨雾林道·拉力赛段七镜
desc: 北欧松林湿砾石赛段，白蓝涂装拉力赛车雨雾中七段六硬切：水坑、驾驶舱、侧跟拍、轮胎特写与飞坡重着地。
original: SCENE CONTEXT: Rally special stage on a wet gravel forest road, Nordic pine woods, low fog, overcast dusk. One rally car runs the stage. Real-time, about 15s, seven segments, six hard cuts. SUBJECT LOCK: One rally car only, white and blue livery, round door number panel, mud-caked flanks, headlights on. Right-hand drive, steering wheel on the right in every exterior and interior shot. Driver in helmet with closed dark visor and gloves, co-driver right of frame in the cockpit. Livery pattern, mud level and light state stay identical across all cuts. SCREEN DIRECTION LOCK: The car travels right-to-left in every exterior shot. Camera stays on one side of the road; the 180 axis never flips. Fog density and road surface stay continuous across cuts. BEATS: 1. Wide static, 47 degree FOV, car exits a bend right-to-left, headlight cone on wet gravel. Hard cut. 2. Wide, tighter framing and lower angle, car hits a standing puddle, fine dispersed water and mud droplets burst outward and fall fast, thin spray that clears within half a second, silhouette of the car never hidden by a solid wall of mud. Hard cut. 3. Cockpit medium, camera on the roll cage, driver right of frame at the right-hand wheel, wipers sweeping in rigid synchronous mechanical arcs across muddy glass, rain beads streaking. Hard cut. 4. 29 degree FOV side tracking pan, car right-to-left, background streaked with motion blur, car sharp. Hard cut. 5. Extreme close-up, 84 degree FOV fender-mounted, tread biting wet gravel, stones and mud flicking off the tyre. Hard cut. 6. Wide static, car launches over the crest right-to-left, a fast clean parabola, apex reached in under half a second, immediate descent, heavy landing with suspension compressing hard, gravel and spray kicked out on impact, car continues out of frame. No hovering, no mid-air pause, no slow motion. Hard cut. 7. Bonnet POV, 84 degree FOV, road rushing forward through fog, final static held beat as the road straightens. PHYSICS: Full gravity and inertia at all times, mass loads the outside suspension in the bend, the body rolls and settles, tyres deform under load. Water breaks into droplets, never into a frozen solid cloud. Mud lands and sticks, spray thins as it rises. Wipers are rigid mechanical arms with a fixed pivot, no bending, no morphing. CAMERA AND OPTICS: Static locked-off or single-axis pan only, camera height 60-90 cm. Shutter 270-360 degrees, long natural motion blur. No zoom, no whip pans, no digital jitter, no effects. LIGHTING: Overcast 6000K daylight through fog as key, soft and directionless. Headlights as the only warm practical, cutting a visible cone in the mist. No unmotivated sources. AUDIO: Turbocharged four-cylinder engine, real gear changes and anti-lag pops. Distinct impact sounds, puddle slap on beat 2, engine rising as the wheels leave the ground on beat 6, hard suspension slam and gravel scatter on landing. Engine level drops with distance and loses high end when the car is far or out of frame. No music. LOOK: Photoreal, shot on ARRI Alexa 35, natural grain, cool teal-green forest grade, wet gravel and mud texture, condensation on glass. No text, no logos beyond the car livery, no watermarks.
zh:
场景背景：北欧松林间湿砾石林道上的拉力特殊赛段，低雾，阴天黄昏。一辆拉力赛车跑完赛段。实时，约15秒，七段，六次硬切。

主体锁定：仅一辆拉力赛车，白蓝涂装，圆形车门号码牌，两侧沾满泥浆，大灯开启。右舵，所有外景与车内镜头中方向盘都在右侧。驾驶员戴头盔、深色面罩闭合、戴手套，领航员在驾驶舱画面右侧。涂装图案、泥浆程度与灯光状态在所有剪切间保持完全一致。

银幕方向锁定：所有外景镜头中赛车都从右向左行驶。摄影机始终停在道路一侧；180度轴线绝不翻转。雾浓度与路面状态在剪切间保持连续。

节拍：1. 大全景静止机位，47度视场角，赛车从右向左驶出弯道，灯锥打在湿砾石上。硬切。2. 全景，取景更紧、角度更低，赛车冲进积水坑，细碎分散的水珠与泥点向外爆开并快速坠落，薄薄的水雾半秒内散尽，车的轮廓绝不被实心泥墙遮没。硬切。3. 驾驶舱中景，摄影机固定在防滚架上，驾驶员在画面右侧握右舵，雨刮以刚性同步的机械弧线扫过泥污玻璃，雨珠拉出条痕。硬切。
4. 29度视场角侧面跟拍横摇，赛车从右向左，背景拉出运动模糊条痕，车身清晰。硬切。5. 大特写，84度视场角翼子板固定机位，胎纹咬进湿砾石，石子与泥浆从轮胎上甩出。硬切。6. 大全景静止机位，赛车从右向左飞越坡顶，快速干净的抛物线，不到半秒到达顶点，随即下落，重着地时悬挂猛烈压缩，砾石与水雾在冲击中溅出，赛车继续驶出画面。无悬停，无空中停顿，无慢动作。硬切。7. 引擎盖POV，84度视场角，道路穿雾向前飞驰，道路转直后的最终静止保持节拍。

物理：全程完整的重力与惯性，弯中质量压向外侧悬挂，车身侧倾后回稳，轮胎在负载下形变。水碎成水珠，绝不冻成实心云团。泥浆落地即粘附，水雾越升越稀。雨刮是带固定转轴的刚性机械臂，不弯曲，不变形。

摄影机与光学：仅静止锁定机位或单轴横摇，机位高度60-90厘米。快门270-360度，长自然运动模糊。无变焦，无甩镜，无数字抖动，无特效。

灯光：透雾的阴天6000K日光为主光，柔和无方向性。大灯是唯一的暖色实用光源，在雾中切出可见光锥。无无动机光源。

音频：涡轮增压四缸引擎，真实换挡与防迟滞回火声。清晰的冲击音效，节拍2的水坑拍击声，节拍6车轮离地时引擎声拔高、着地时悬挂重响与砾石四溅。引擎声随距离减弱，车远或出画时高频衰减。无音乐。

质感：照片级真实，ARRI Alexa 35拍摄，自然颗粒，冷调青绿森林调色，湿砾石与泥浆质感，玻璃凝结水汽。无文字，除赛车涂装外无标志，无水印。

name: 巨塔峡谷·战机低飞一镜
desc: 未来单座战机贴地穿行巨城塔楼峡谷，环绕入正后方的10秒连续追拍，刚体物理与天桥下光影过渡。
original: SCENE: A single-seat futuristic fighter runs low through the canyon between megacity towers. One continuous take, about 10 seconds, real-time. SUBJECT: One fighter only, white-grey worn hull with red stripes on nose and wings, twin engine nozzles glowing blue, glazed canopy with a helmeted pilot visible. Hull is rigid metal, panel lines, scratches and proportions stay identical from first to last frame. CAMERA: Single continuous chase, no cuts. Starts rear-three-quarter left, arcs around the fuselage as the jet banks, passes under a skybridge, settles dead astern by the end. Camera speed constant, subtle air-turbulence micro-shake only. 47 degree field of view, shutter 270-360 degrees, no zoom punches, no speed ramps. FLIGHT PATH: The jet travels screen-left to screen-right for the whole take and never reverses direction. It banks left through a wide arc, levels out, drops under the skybridge, then accelerates straight into depth. Towers, bridges and traffic lanes pass at a consistent rate that reads the speed. PHYSICS: Rigid-body aircraft, nose, wings, tail and nozzles move as one solid unit through the bank, zero flex, zero independent drift of the tail section. Wingtips hold exact length and dihedral at maximum roll. Engine exhaust pushes a visible heat shimmer that distorts the towers behind the nozzles, with a faint ionized wake. Background traffic ships keep continuous trajectories, none pop in or vanish. LIGHTING: One motivated key, hard sun high and camera-right, held at the same angle for the entire take, raking the upper hull and leaving the lower fuselage in cool bounce from the glass towers. Passing under the skybridge, the jet and the frame darken and recover naturally. Anamorphic blue flare appears only when the sun is actually in frame, never as a random burst. AUDIO: Low turbine roar with the source panned to follow the jet across the stereo field, dopplering as it swings. Under the bridge the sound goes muffled and reflective for a moment, then opens up. Distant city hum underneath. No music. LOOK: Photoreal, shot on ARRI Alexa 35, cool grey-blue metropolis grade against warm sun, soft contrast with detail held in shadow, fine grain, real metal wear. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
zh:
场景：一架单座未来战机在巨型都市塔楼间的峡谷中低空疾驰。单一连续镜头，约10秒，实时。

主体：仅一架战机，白灰色磨损机身，机鼻与机翼有红色条纹，双引擎喷口泛蓝光，透明座舱罩内可见戴头盔的飞行员。机身为刚性金属，蒙皮接缝、划痕与比例从首帧到末帧保持完全一致。

摄影机：单一连续追拍，无剪切。从左后四分之三方位起步，随战机压坡沿机身弧线环绕，穿过一座天桥下方，结尾稳定落在正后方。摄影机速度恒定，仅有细微的气流微震。47度视场角，快门270-360度，无变焦冲击，无变速。

飞行路径：整个镜头中战机从画左向画右飞行，绝不反向。它先向左压坡划出大弧线，改平，下降穿过天桥，随后加速直线冲向纵深。塔楼、天桥与交通航道以稳定的速率掠过，读出速度感。

物理：刚体飞行器，机鼻、机翼、尾翼与喷口在压坡中作为一个整体移动，零弯曲，尾段零独立漂移。最大滚转时翼尖保持精确的长度与上反角。引擎尾流推出可见热扰动，扭曲喷口后方的塔楼，并带淡淡的电离尾迹。背景交通飞船保持连续轨迹，无凭空出现或消失。

灯光：单一有动机主光，硬太阳光高悬于画右，整个镜头保持同一角度，斜扫机身上部，机腹落在玻璃塔楼反弹的冷调补光中。穿过天桥下方时，战机与画面自然变暗再恢复。变形镜头蓝色眩光只在太阳真正入画时出现，绝非随机爆闪。

音频：低沉涡轮轰鸣，声源随战机在立体声场中平移，摆动时带多普勒效应。桥下瞬间声音变闷、带反射感，随后重新开阔。底层是遥远的城市嗡鸣。无音乐。

质感：照片级真实，ARRI Alexa 35拍摄，冷灰蓝都市调色衬暖阳，柔对比且阴影留有细节，细腻颗粒，真实金属磨损。无文字，无标志，无水印。

name: 黑洞吞噬·事件视界六镜
desc: 微型飞船逼近巨型黑洞并越过事件视界，吸积盘逆光下六段硬切：POV光流隧道、面罩反光与终局寂灭。
original: GLOBAL STYLE: Epic cinematic photoreal footage, Fine Film texture with natural film grain, epic teal-and-orange grade pushed into deep violet, neon pink and fiery orange against cosmic black, contre-jour motivated lighting only: the accretion disk is the single light source in the entire video. 16:9 frame. Shutter 300°, heavy natural motion blur on light streaks and head movement. No digital effects, no glitch, no overlays. Suit fabric, skin and cockpit surfaces keep real texture with pores and scuffs, never plastic. Clean readable frames, no clutter, no readable text, no UI overlays. SCENE: A small metallic spaceship approaches a gargantuan black hole, crosses the event horizon, and is swallowed by the void while the pilot watches in terror. CHARACTER: A middle-aged male astronaut with pale skin, blue eyes and visible worry lines, wearing a bulky realistic grey NASA-style suit with a clear reflective helmet visor. His face is fully readable behind the visor in the close beats. LOCATION: Deep space, pitch black with faint distant stars. The black hole dominates the frame: a swirling accretion disk radiating intense pink, violet and red-orange light around an absolute black core. FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: the first frame already contains the ship, a tiny silhouette at x 50%, y 68%, with the black hole filling the upper two-thirds of the frame, the disk tilted so its full ellipse reads clearly. Shot 1 — extreme wide: the tiny ship drifts toward the disk; a slow committed dolly-in follows it; the scale gap is terrifying. Hard cut. Shot 2 — immersive POV crossing the event horizon: disk light stretches into long warping streaks of pink, blue and white that tunnel around the camera in a fast forward rush. Hard cut. Shot 3 — static extreme close-up of the astronaut's face behind the visor: pink and violet reflections warp across the glass, his eyes widen. Hard cut. Shot 4 — medium-wide: the ship hangs at the edge of the black core while the glowing disk bends violently behind it, gravity swallowing the light. Hard cut. Shot 5 — static close-up: rapidly flickering purple-red reflections on his face; his mouth opens in a throat-straining scream of absolute terror. Hard cut. Shot 6 — wide: the surrounding light streaks race toward the center point and die; the ship shrinks to a speck and vanishes into pitch black. Sudden total silence. OPTICS: 50° diagonal field of view with anamorphic character for the space wides, the disk's ellipse fully readable; 29° short telephoto for the cockpit close-ups, face sharp, cockpit melt into soft oval bokeh. Lens lock per beat. CAMERA: Epic Scale moveset: slow committed dolly-ins, one violent POV rush, locked static frames for the face beats. Weighted, physical, no jitter. PHYSICS: the ship's drift carries slow inertia; the POV streaks bend with gravitational warp; the scream strains the neck and jaw muscles; the final fade is light being trapped, not a dissolve. LIGHTING: contre-jour lock: the disk always sits behind or around the subject, so ship and astronaut read as rim-lit silhouettes against it; faces are carried by reflected disk light from the visor side only; expose for the disk, let everything else fall toward black. AUDIO: deep sub-bass rumble, rising alarm pulses, close suit breathing, one full scream that cuts off into absolute silence. No dialogue, no music.
zh:
全局风格：史诗级电影感照片级真实影像，精细胶片质感与自然胶片颗粒，史诗青橙调色推向深紫罗兰、霓虹粉与炽焰橙对宇宙纯黑，仅逆光有动机照明：吸积盘是全片唯一光源。16:9画幅。快门300°，光带与头部运动带浓重自然运动模糊。无数字特效，无故障效果，无叠加层。宇航服布料、皮肤与座舱表面保持真实质感，有毛孔与磨痕，绝不塑料感。画面干净可读，无杂乱，无可读文字，无UI叠加。

场景：一艘小型金属飞船逼近巨型黑洞，越过事件视界，在飞行员惊恐注视中被虚空吞没。

角色：中年男性宇航员，苍白皮肤，蓝眼睛，可见愁纹，穿臃肿写实的灰色NASA风格宇航服，透明反光头盔面罩。近景节拍中他的脸在面罩后完全可读。

场地：深空，漆黑中缀着微弱远星。黑洞主宰画面：旋转的吸积盘绕着绝对黑色的核心，辐射出强烈的粉、紫与红橙光。

首帧与走位：首帧即包含飞船，一个位于x 50%、y 68%的微小剪影，黑洞占据画面上三分之二，盘面倾斜使其完整椭圆清晰可读。

镜头1——大远景：微小飞船漂向吸积盘；缓慢坚定的推轨跟进；尺度差令人恐惧。硬切。镜头2——沉浸式POV越过事件视界：盘光拉伸成粉、蓝、白的长扭曲光带，在快速前冲中绕摄影机成隧道。硬切。
镜头3——面罩后宇航员面部的静止大特写：粉与紫的反光在玻璃上扭曲流过，他的双眼骤然睜大。硬切。镜头4——中全景：飞船悬在纯黑核心边缘，发光的吸积盘在其身后剧烈弯折，引力正吞噬光线。硬切。镜头5——静止特写：他脸上急速闪烁的紫红反光；他张口发出撕裂喉咙的绝对恐惧斯吼。硬切。镜头6——全景：周围光带全部冲向中心点并熄灭；飞船缩成一个光点，消失于漆黑。骤然彻底寂静。

光学：太空全景用50°对角线视场角并带变形镜头特性，吸积盘椭圆完整可读；座舱特写用29°短长焦，面部锐利，座舱融成柔和椭圆焦外。每节拍镜头锁定。

摄影机：史诗尺度运动组：缓慢坚定的推轨，一次猛烈的POV冲刺，面部节拍用锁定静止画面。有配重、有实体感，无抖动。

物理：飞船的漂移带缓慢惯性；POV光带随引力扭曲弯折；斯吼绷紧颈部与下颃肌肉；最终的暗灭是光被囚禁，而非叠化。

灯光：逆光锁定：吸积盘始终位于主体身后或四周，飞船与宇航员读作衬着盘光的轮廓剪影；面部只靠面罩一侧反射的盘光托起；按吸积盘曝光，让其余一切沉向黑暗。

音频：深沉的次低音轰鸣，渐强的警报脉冲，贴近的宇航服呼吸声，一声完整的斯吼骤然切入绝对寂静。无对白，无音乐。

name: 超现实工作室·设计师开场钩子
desc: 粉彩超现实工作室一侧融入海岸草坡，年轻设计师七镜连贯口播开场，甩镜、快推快拉与逆光锁定。
original: GLOBAL STYLE: Epic cinematic photoreal footage, Fine Film texture with natural film grain, epic teal-and-orange grade in a pastel register: warm terracotta, peach and skin tones against cool lavender and sky-blue shadow. Contre-jour motivated lighting only: a huge soft daylight source pouring from the open landscape side behind her, her face carried by warm bounce off the floor and desk. Horizontal 16:9 frame. Shutter 300°, heavy natural motion blur on spins, whips and fast gestures. No digital effects, no glitch, no overlays, no UI cards or interface frames. Real skin with pores, freckles and flyaway hairs, never waxy or plastic. Clean readable studio geography, no clutter, no readable text on any screen or print, no logos, no floating props. SCENE: A surreal open-plan creative studio that dissolves on one side into a grassy coastline. A young designer stops the viewer's scroll, walks the space, and hooks them with two promised tricks. CHARACTER: A woman in her mid-twenties with medium-toned skin and light freckles across nose and cheeks, a dark brown shoulder-length softly waved bob, brown eyes, red-berry lipstick. Oversized cream blazer over a slate-blue scoop-neck camisole, black high-waisted straight trousers, gold hoops, a delicate gold chain, several gold rings including a band on her right index finger. Warm, expressive, confident. LOCATION: A seamless surreal space: screen-left a curved wall split horizontally between pastel terracotta below and pastel lilac above, a small potted palm at its base; center a textured light-grey mood-board wall with pinned prints of interiors, architecture, abstract gradients and a beach sunset, a curved white desk in front of it styled with a laptop, ceramic teaware, two glasses with orange liquid and a small flower arrangement, a light-grey rug beneath; screen-right the floor opens into a grassy hillside under a bright partly cloudy sky, a large orange-peach abstract lounge chair in the near FG. Large matte spheres in blue, green and yellow rest on the floor and on low pedestals at the frame edges. The center walking path stays clear and readable. FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: the first frame already contains the woman in extreme close-up, x 50%, y 50%, eyes locked into the lens. Shot 1 — extreme close on her face: she says "Stop scrolling." and sweeps her hand up to cover the lens; whip pan right as she turns away. Shot 2 — fast backward track: she walks into the studio turning back to camera, presenting the space with an open welcoming gesture, the whole surreal room unfolding around her; whip pan down. Shot 3 — extreme close insert: a thumb rapidly scrolls a smartphone feed, the screen a soft abstract blur of color blocks without any readable text, bright white glare. Shot 4 — medium-wide: seen from behind she walks to the mood board, gestures across the pinned prints, then turns and walks back toward center as the camera tracks slowly backward. Shot 5 — quick push-in to medium close: she steps in and raises her right index finger beside her face, a "one second" gesture, eyes bright. Shot 6 — rapid zoom past her finger to the mood board: the black-and-white brutalist architecture print catches a focused shaft of daylight and glows while the rest of the wall falls into soft shade. Shot 7 — instant pull-back to a static medium: she stands center frame, points her index finger straight into the lens with an encouraging smile and says "Two tricks make it happen. Watch." Hold on her pointing smile as the final frame. OPTICS: 50° diagonal field of view with anamorphic character for the walk and studio beats, the surreal space fully readable, straight lines clean; 29° short telephoto for the close beats, face and the raised finger razor-sharp, the studio melting into oval bokeh. Lens lock per beat, no drift. CAMERA: Epic Scale moveset: handheld-intimate close beats, committed backward tracking, whip pans with real angular momentum, one rapid zoom and an instant pull-back to a locked final frame. Physical operator weight, no digital jitter. PHYSICS: her blazer swings with each turn and settles with fabric delay; her bob lags head movement; the thumb's scroll carries finger friction; the palm fronds and grass move in the coastal breeze; the prints stay pinned and flutter slightly. LIGHTING: contre-jour lock: the big soft daylight sits behind her on the landscape side, so she is rim-lit through her hair and blazer edges with her face carried by warm bounce; the camera stays on the shadow side; the mood-board shaft appears only in beat 6; expose for the bright landscape, let the interior walls fall into pastel shade. AUDIO: an upbeat modern music bed, soft whooshes on the whips, her footsteps, distant ocean wash from the open side, and only these scripted lines spoken straight to camera: "Stop scrolling." and "Two tricks make it happen. Watch." Lips move only for the scripted lines. No other voices.

全局风格：史诗级电影感照片级真实影像，精细胶片质感与自然胶片颗粒，史诗青橙调色走粉彩音区：暖陶土、蜜桃与肤色对冷薰衣草与天蓝阴影。仅逆光有动机照明：巨大柔和的日光从她身后开放的景观一侧倾泻而入，面部靠地板与桌面反弹的暖光托起。横向16:9画幅。快门300°，旋转、甩镜与快速手势带浓重自然运动模糊。无数字特效，无故障效果，无叠加层，无UI卡片或界面框。真实皮肤，有毛孔、雀斑与飞翘碎发，绝不蜡感或塑料感。工作室地理关系干净可读，无杂乱，任何屏幕或印刷品上无可读文字，无标志，无漂浮道具。

场景：一间超现实开放式创意工作室，一侧消融为长草的海岸线。年轻设计师拦住观众的滑动，走过空间，用两个许诺的技巧钩住他们。

角色：二十五六岁女性，中等肤色，鼻颅有浅雀斑，深棕色及肩柔波浪波波头，棕眼睛，红莓色唇膏。奶油色oversize西装外套罩石板蓝圆领吊带，黑色高腰直筒裤，金圈耳环，细金链，数枚金戒指、右手食指戴一枚素圈。温暖、生动、自信。
场地：一个无缝衔接的超现实空间：画左是一面弧形墙，水平分为下半粉彩陶土色与上半粉彩丁香紫，墙脚有一株小盆栽棕榈；中央是带纹理的浅灰情绪板墙，钉着室内设计、建筑、抽象渐变与海滩日落的印刷图片，墙前一张弧形白色书桌，桌上摆着笔记本电脑、陶瓷茶具、两杯橙色液体与一小束插花，桌下铺浅灰地毯；画右地面敞开为明亮多云天空下的青草山坡，近前景有一把橙桃色抽象造型休闲椅。蓝、绿、黄的大型哑光球体散落在地面与画框边缘的矮座上。中央走动路径保持干净可读。

首帧与走位：首帧即包含处于大特写中的女子，x 50%、y 50%，双眼锁定镜头。

镜头1——面部大特写：她说“Stop scrolling.”（别再滑了。）并抬手扫上来遮住镜头；她转身时甩镜向右。镜头2——快速后退跟拍：她走进工作室，回身面向镜头，以开放的欢迎手势展示空间，整个超现实房间在她周围铺展开来；甩镜向下。镜头3——大特写插入：拇指快速滑动智能手机信息流，屏幕是无任何可读文字的柔和抽象色块模糊，泛亮白眩光。镜头4——中全景：从背后看她走向情绪板，手势扫过钉着的图片，随后转身走回中央，摄影机缓慢后退跟拍。
镜头5——快速推近至中近景：她上前一步，在脸旁竖起右手食指，做“稍等”手势，眼神发亮。镜头6——快速变焦越过她的手指冲向情绪板：黑白粗野主义建筑图片接住一道聚焦的日光束而发亮，墙面其余部分落入柔和阴影。镜头7——瞬间拉回至静止中景：她站在画面中央，食指直指镜头，带着鼓励的微笑说“Two tricks make it happen. Watch.”（两个技巧就能实现。看着。）定格在她指向镜头的微笑上作为最终帧。

光学：50度对角线视场角带变形镜头特性，用于行走与工作室节拍，超现实空间完整可读，直线干净；29度短长焦用于近景节拍，面部与竖起的手指锐利如刃，工作室融成椭圆焦外。每节拍镜头锁定，无漂移。

摄影机：史诗尺度运动组：手持亲密的近景节拍，坚定的后退跟拍，带真实角动量的甩镜，一次快速变焦与一次瞬间拉回至锁定终帧。真实掌机人重量感，无数字抖动。

物理：西装外套随每次转身摆动并带织物延迟回落；波波头滞后于头部运动；拇指滑动带指尖摩擦；棕榈叶与草地随海岸微风摆动；图片保持钉住并轻微飘动。

灯光：逆光锁定：巨大柔和的日光位于她身后景观一侧，发丝与外套边缘勾出轮廓光，面部由暖反弹光托起；摄影机始终在阴影侧；情绪板光束仅在节拍6出现；按明亮景观曝光，让室内墙面落入粉彩阴影。

音频：轻快现代的音乐底床，甩镜时的轻柔呼啸声，她的脚步声，开放一侧传来的远海涛声，且只有这些台词直面镜头说出：“Stop scrolling.”（别再滑了。）与“Two tricks make it happen. Watch.”（两个技巧就能实现。看着。）嘴唇只为台词而动。无其他人声。

name: 酒店走廊·女谍电梯搏杀
desc: 女特工酒店走廊遭杀手偷袭，30秒六段近身战：肘击、夺枪、避刃撞碎玻璃桌，电梯内制敌后冷面出场。
original:
FEMALE SPY vs. ASSASSIN — 30-SECOND CINEMATIC FIGHT

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, ultra-realistic cinematic action, premium spy-thriller aesthetic, fast-paced editing, dramatic lighting, dynamic camera movement, realistic choreography.

MAIN CHARACTER: A confident female spy in her late 20s, athletic build, sharp features, sleek black tactical suit, black boots, hair tied in a tight ponytail. She is calm, highly skilled, and intimidating. Maintain the exact facial features, eye color, skin tone, hair color, and overall identity from the provided character reference throughout every shot.

0–4 SEC — HOTEL HALLWAY
The female spy walks alone through a luxurious dimly lit hotel hallway. She suddenly stops. An assassin appears behind her. She turns instantly as he throws the first punch.
4–9 SEC — HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT
Rapid close-quarters combat. She blocks a punch, delivers a powerful elbow strike, ducks under another attack, spins and kicks him into the wall. Fast cuts, whip pans, impact close-ups.

9–14 SEC — GUN DISARM
The assassin pulls a handgun. She grabs his wrist before he can fire, twists his arm, strips the gun away, and kicks him backward. The gun slides across the polished floor.
14–19 SEC — KNIFE ATTACK
He suddenly pulls a knife and lunges. She narrowly dodges the blade, grabs his arm, redirects the attack, and sends him crashing through a glass table. Glass explodes in slow motion.

19–25 SEC — ELEVATOR FIGHT
The spy rushes into an elevator. The assassin follows. The doors close as they continue fighting inside the tight space. She uses the elevator walls for leverage, flips him down, and pins him against the floor.
25–30 SEC — FINAL MOMENT
The elevator doors open. She calmly steps out and straightens her jacket. Behind her, the defeated assassin remains on the floor. The doors slowly close.

FINAL CLOSE-UP: She looks directly toward the camera with a cold, confident expression.
CUT TO BLACK.
zh:
女特工对决杀手——30秒电影级打斗

格式：16:9宽银幕，超写实电影级动作，高级谍战惊悚片美学，快节奏剪辑，戏剧性灯光，动态摄影机运动，写实武打设计。

主角：一名自信的女特工，接近三十岁，运动型身材，轮廓分明，紧身黑色战术服，黑色靴子，头发扎成利落马尾。她冷静、身手极高、气场攝人。所有镜头中保持与所给角色参考完全一致的面部特征、瞳色、肤色、发色与整体身份。

0-4秒——酒店走廊
女特工独自走过灯光昏暗的豪华酒店走廊。她突然停步。一名杀手出现在她身后。对方挥出第一拳的瞬间她立刻转身。

4-9秒——徒手近战
急速近身格斗。她格开一拳，送出有力的肘击，低身躲过又一次进攻，旋身一脚把他踢到墙上。快切，甩镜，冲击特写。

9-14秒——夺枪
杀手拔出手枪。她在他开火前抓住其手腕，拧臂缴枪，一脚将他踹退。手枪滑过抛光地面。

14-19秒——刀袭
他突然拔刀扑来。她堪堪避过刀锋，抓住他的手臂，引偏攻势，把他揀翻撞碎玻璃桌。玻璃在慢动作中爆开。

19-25秒——电梯之战
女特工冲进电梯。杀手跟入。门在两人缠斗中关闭。狭小空间里她借电梯壁发力，将他摧倒并压制在地板上。

25-30秒——终局时刻
电梯门打开。她平静走出，整了整外套。身后，被击败的杀手瘫在地板上。门缓缓关闭。

最终特写：她目光直视镜头，神情冷峻自信。
切至黑场。
